en.title: Determination of Manganese in Silicomanganese by the Volhard (Alternate) Method
en.purpose: To find the manganese content of silicomanganese by the Volhard method: zinc oxide treatment and titration with standard potassium permanganate.
en.scope: This WI covers manganese in silicomanganese by the Volhard (alternate) method (IS 1559 cl. 26, with cl. 20). IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) covers the analysis of ferro-alloys, including silicomanganese of the composition ranges given in Appendix A.
en.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 24.4.1, 25.3.1, 26 (with 20 referred; 19.2.7, 7.3.1, 6.3.1), Appendix A
en.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: Mn 65 to 75 percent.
en.principle: (cl. 20.1) Iron hydroxide in the filtrate from the silicon test is precipitated with zinc oxide and filtered. Bivalent manganese in the filtrate is found by oxidizing it to the quadrivalent state with standard permanganate solution.
apparatus: Gooch crucible or fritted glass crucible of fine porosity; dark-coloured glass-stoppered bottle (for permanganate, cl. 19.2.7)

reagents.name: Concentrated sulphuric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.84, as per IS 266-1950 (since revised) (cl. 20.2.1; see 7.3.1).

reagents.name: Sodium carbonate solution
reagents.prep: Dissolve 318 g of anhydrous sodium carbonate in water and make up to 1 litre (cl. 20.2.2).

reagents.name: Zinc oxide emulsion
reagents.prep: Make a suspension of finely divided zinc oxide: shake 50 g of the reagent well in 300 ml of water. Prepare fresh as needed (cl. 20.2.3).

reagents.name: Concentrated nitric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.42, as per IS 264-1950 (since revised) (cl. 20.2.4; see 6.3.1).

reagents.name: Standard potassium permanganate solution, 0.1 N
reagents.prep: (cl. 20.2.5; see 19.2.7) Dissolve 3.2 g of potassium permanganate in 1 litre of water. Keep in the dark for 2 weeks. Filter without washing through a Gooch crucible or fritted glass crucible of fine porosity; avoid contact with rubber or other organic material. Store in a dark-coloured glass-stoppered bottle. Standardize: weigh 0.134 g of Analar sodium oxalate, dissolve in 250 ml of dilute sulphuric acid (5 : 95) and titrate with the permanganate at 55 to 60 °C to a faint pink end point. Adjust the strength so that 0.134 g of sodium oxalate needs exactly 20 ml of permanganate solution. For Volhard's titration it is better to standardize the permanganate against standard ferromanganese or manganese ore of known manganese content.

en.sampling: Use the filtrate kept from the silicon test (cl. 24.4.1; DM/QA/WI/27). It comes from 0.5 g of sample.
procedure: Take the solution kept under cl. 24.4.1. Add 10 ml of concentrated sulphuric acid and evaporate to fumes (cl. 25.3.1).
Cool. Dilute carefully to 100 ml. Boil until all the salts dissolve.
Transfer to a 500-ml flask and make up to the mark.
Pipette 25 ml of this solution into a 500-ml conical flask (cl. 26.1.1, 20.3.1). For lower percentages a suitable aliquot may be taken.
Add zinc oxide emulsion in small amounts until the liquid suddenly coagulates.
Dilute the contents to 200 ml. Boil.
Add 2 to 3 drops of concentrated nitric acid. Titrate with standard potassium permanganate solution.

The permanganate forms a precipitate which clouds the liquid. So titrate with care. Shake the flask after each addition. Let the precipitate settle enough to see whether the solution is pink or not (cl. 20.3.2).
When the clear liquid on top shows a lasting pink tinge, heat the flask nearly to boiling once more. Check again if the pink still stays. Add more permanganate solution if needed.
In this end test do not actually boil the liquid. Boiling can slowly destroy the colour, and the end point can be passed by a large amount.
When the colour stays permanent, the end point is reached.
Make 3 separate titrations. The first 2 titrations give pilot readings. In the final titration add all the permanganate needed as quickly as possible, then observe the colour.
en.end_point: Pink colour of the clear liquid stays permanent, also after heating once more nearly to boiling (cl. 20.3.2).
calculation: Manganese, percent = (A × B × 1.666) / C  (cl. 20.4)
where A = volume in ml of the standard permanganate solution consumed,
B = normality of the standard permanganate solution, and
C = weight in g of the sample represented by the aliquot used (for 0.5 g sample made up to 500 ml, a 25 ml aliquot represents 0.025 g; arithmetic from 24.4.1 and 25.3.1).
en.reporting: Round off as per IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) (IS 1559 cl. 0.6).
notes: Cl. 26.1.1 change: pipette 25 ml of the solution made under cl. 25.3.1 (silicomanganese) and complete the test as in cl. 20.3.1 to 20.4. Cl. 20.3.1 itself refers to the solution of cl. 19.3.1 (ferromanganese).
Cl. 20.1 (outline) says the iron hydroxide precipitated by zinc oxide is filtered, but cl. 20.3 gives no filtration step (as printed in IS).
Sodium carbonate solution (cl. 20.2.2) is listed in the reagents but is not used in cl. 20.3 (as printed in IS).
Cl. 20.2.3 reads 'finally divided' zinc oxide (as printed in IS); read as finely divided.
The same stock solution (steps a to c) is also used for the Bismuthate method, DM/QA/WI/28 (cl. 25).

Quality of reagents (cl. 3.1): unless stated otherwise, use pure chemicals and distilled water [see IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)]. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that have no impurities which affect the results.
Sampling (cl. 2.1): draw and prepare samples as per IS 1472 (Part I)-1959. As per cl. 0.5 the latest version applies: IS 1472 : 1977, see DM/QA/SOP/02.

hi.title: Volhard (Alternate) विधि द्वारा Silicomanganese में Manganese का निर्धारण
hi.purpose: Volhard विधि द्वारा silicomanganese में manganese की मात्रा ज्ञात करना: zinc oxide treatment और standard potassium permanganate से titration।
hi.scope: यह WI Volhard (alternate) विधि द्वारा silicomanganese में manganese के लिए है (IS 1559 cl. 26, cl. 20 के साथ)। IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) ferro-alloys के विश्लेषण के लिए है, जिसमें Appendix A में दी गई संरचना-सीमा वाला silicomanganese भी शामिल है।
hi.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 24.4.1, 25.3.1, 26 (with 20 referred; 19.2.7, 7.3.1, 6.3.1), Appendix A
hi.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: Mn 65 से 75 percent।
hi.principle: (cl. 20.1) Silicon test के filtrate में मौजूद iron hydroxide को zinc oxide से precipitate करके filter किया जाता है। Filtrate में bivalent manganese को standard permanganate solution से quadrivalent अवस्था में oxidize करके ज्ञात किया जाता है।
apparatus: Gooch crucible या fine porosity वाला fritted glass crucible; गहरे रंग की glass-stoppered bottle (permanganate के लिए, cl. 19.2.7)

reagents.name: Concentrated sulphuric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.84, IS 266-1950 (since revised) के अनुसार (cl. 20.2.1; देखें 7.3.1)।

reagents.name: Sodium carbonate solution
reagents.prep: 318 g anhydrous sodium carbonate पानी में घोलें और 1 litre तक बनाएँ (cl. 20.2.2)।

reagents.name: Zinc oxide emulsion
reagents.prep: बारीक पिसे zinc oxide का suspension बनाएँ: 50 g reagent को 300 ml पानी में अच्छी तरह हिलाएँ। ज़रूरत के अनुसार ताज़ा बनाएँ (cl. 20.2.3)।

reagents.name: Concentrated nitric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.42, IS 264-1950 (since revised) के अनुसार (cl. 20.2.4; देखें 6.3.1)।

reagents.name: Standard potassium permanganate solution, 0.1 N
reagents.prep: (cl. 20.2.5; देखें 19.2.7) 3.2 g potassium permanganate को 1 litre पानी में घोलें। 2 सप्ताह अंधेरे में रखें। बिना धोए Gooch crucible या fine porosity वाले fritted glass crucible से filter करें; rubber या अन्य organic पदार्थ के संपर्क से बचाएँ। गहरे रंग की glass-stoppered bottle में रखें। Standardize करें: 0.134 g Analar sodium oxalate तौलें, 250 ml dilute sulphuric acid (5 : 95) में घोलें और 55 से 60 °C पर permanganate से हल्के गुलाबी end point तक titrate करें। Strength ऐसे adjust करें कि 0.134 g sodium oxalate के लिए ठीक 20 ml permanganate solution लगे। Volhard titration के लिए permanganate को ज्ञात manganese वाले standard ferromanganese या manganese ore से standardize करना बेहतर है।

hi.sampling: Silicon test से रखा गया filtrate प्रयोग करें (cl. 24.4.1; DM/QA/WI/27)। यह 0.5 g नमूने से बना है।
procedure: Cl. 24.4.1 में रखा गया solution लें। 10 ml concentrated sulphuric acid डालें और fumes आने तक evaporate करें (cl. 25.3.1)।
ठंडा करें। सावधानी से 100 ml तक dilute करें। सभी salts घुलने तक उबालें।
500-ml flask में डालें और mark तक भरें।
इस solution का 25 ml, 500-ml conical flask में pipette करें (cl. 26.1.1, 20.3.1)। कम प्रतिशत के लिए उपयुक्त aliquot लिया जा सकता है।
थोड़ा-थोड़ा करके zinc oxide emulsion तब तक डालें जब तक liquid अचानक coagulate (जम) न हो जाए।
Contents को 200 ml तक dilute करें। उबालें।
2 से 3 बूँद concentrated nitric acid डालें। Standard potassium permanganate solution से titrate करें।

Permanganate से precipitate बनता है जो liquid को धुंधला कर देता है। इसलिए सावधानी से titrate करें। हर बार डालने के बाद flask हिलाएँ। Precipitate को इतना बैठने दें कि दिख सके कि solution गुलाबी है या नहीं (cl. 20.3.2)।
जब ऊपर का साफ़ liquid स्थायी गुलाबी झलक दिखाए, flask को एक बार फिर लगभग उबाल तक गर्म करें। फिर देखें कि गुलाबी रंग बना रहता है या नहीं। ज़रूरत हो तो और permanganate solution डालें।
इस end test में liquid को वास्तव में न उबालें। उबालने से रंग धीरे-धीरे नष्ट हो सकता है और end point बहुत आगे निकल सकता है।
जब रंग स्थायी रहे, end point आ गया है।
3 अलग titrations करें। पहले 2 titrations से pilot readings लें। अंतिम titration में ज़रूरी पूरा permanganate जितनी जल्दी हो सके डालें, फिर रंग देखें।
hi.end_point: साफ़ liquid का गुलाबी रंग स्थायी रहे, एक बार फिर लगभग उबाल तक गर्म करने के बाद भी (cl. 20.3.2)।
calculation: Manganese, percent = (A × B × 1.666) / C  (cl. 20.4)
जहाँ A = खर्च हुआ standard permanganate solution, ml में,
B = standard permanganate solution की normality, और
C = प्रयुक्त aliquot द्वारा दर्शाया गया नमूने का वजन g में (0.5 g नमूना 500 ml में बनाने पर, 25 ml aliquot = 0.025 g; गणना 24.4.1 और 25.3.1 से)।
hi.reporting: IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) के अनुसार round off करें (IS 1559 cl. 0.6)।
notes: Cl. 26.1.1 बदलाव: cl. 25.3.1 में बने solution (silicomanganese) का 25 ml pipette करें और test cl. 20.3.1 से 20.4 की तरह पूरा करें। Cl. 20.3.1 स्वयं cl. 19.3.1 (ferromanganese) के solution का संदर्भ देता है।
Cl. 20.1 (outline) में लिखा है कि zinc oxide से precipitate हुआ iron hydroxide filter किया जाता है, पर cl. 20.3 में filtration का कोई step नहीं है (IS में जैसा छपा है)।
Sodium carbonate solution (cl. 20.2.2) reagents में दिया है पर cl. 20.3 में प्रयोग नहीं होता (IS में जैसा छपा है)।
Cl. 20.2.3 में 'finally divided' zinc oxide छपा है (IS में जैसा छपा है); इसे finely divided (बारीक पिसा) पढ़ें।
यही stock solution (steps a से c) Bismuthate विधि, DM/QA/WI/28 (cl. 25) के लिए भी प्रयोग होता है।

Reagents की गुणवत्ता (cl. 3.1): जब तक अलग न कहा जाए, pure chemicals और distilled water [देखें IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)] प्रयोग करें। 'Pure chemicals' का अर्थ है ऐसे chemicals जिनमें परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाली अशुद्धियाँ न हों।
Sampling (cl. 2.1): नमूने IS 1472 (Part I)-1959 के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें। Cl. 0.5 के अनुसार नवीनतम संस्करण लागू है: IS 1472 : 1977, देखें DM/QA/SOP/02।

keywords: carbon c% combustion silico manganese simn carbon in simn (gravimetric)

en.title: Determination of Carbon (Total) in Silicomanganese by the Direct Combustion Gravimetric Method
en.purpose: To find the total carbon content of silicomanganese by direct combustion in oxygen and weighing of the carbon dioxide formed.
en.scope: This WI covers total carbon in silicomanganese by the direct combustion gravimetric method (IS 1559 cl. 27, with cl. 7). IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) covers the analysis of ferro-alloys, including silicomanganese of the composition ranges given in Appendix A.
en.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 27 (with 7 referred), Appendix A
en.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: C 2.0 percent Max.
en.principle: (cl. 7.1) Burn the sample in a stream of pure oxygen. Remove the contaminants from the gas. Absorb the carbon dioxide formed in soda asbestos. The increase in weight of the absorbent is proportional to the carbon content.
apparatus: Source of oxygen supply (Fig. 1): gas holder A (capacity 8 to 10 litres) containing 99.5 percent oxygen, free from carbonaceous matter, joined by rubber tubing to the gas purifying train. Fill the gas holder before starting (cl. 7.2.1).

Oxygen purification train: Arnold bottles (B) and (C), the latter containing concentrated sulphuric acid, exit bulb packed with glass wool, and absorption bottle (D) containing soda asbestos which passes IS Sieve 140 but is retained on IS Sieve 50 and 'anhydrone' in layers. These are joined in series between the gas holder and the inlet of the combustion tube. A layer of about 12 mm of anhydrone on top removes moisture and the soda asbestos removes carbon dioxide (cl. 7.2.2).
Furnace: horizontal tube furnace (E) heated to 1 350 °C by electricity (cl. 7.2.3); for silicomanganese run it at 1 200 to 1 300 °C (cl. 27.1.2).

Combustion tube: about 650 mm long, 20 mm inner diameter, of fused silica, fireclay or other suitable material. Place an ignited asbestos plug, 75 mm long, lightly in the exit end to hold back ferric oxide (cl. 7.2.4).

Absorption train (cl. 7.2.5): Arnold bottle (F) to stop back suction; gas absorption bottle (G) with chromic anhydride in dilute sulphuric acid 2 : 1 (v/v) to remove oxides of sulphur; bottle (H) with about 40 ml concentrated sulphuric acid, exit end filled with glass wool; tube (J) with 'anhydrone' or other suitable desiccant; carbon dioxide absorption bottle (K) (80 ml capacity) with uniformly graded, evenly packed soda asbestos or ascarite with a layer of anhydrone on top, fillings held by small plugs of glass wool; guard bottle (L) packed in the same way, exit joined to a flowmeter. Bottles (F), (G) and (H) may be replaced by a Midvale or Nesbitt bulb (N) containing precipitated manganese dioxide over ignited asbestos.
Combustion boat of porcelain, refractory clay, nickel sheet or alumina, about 100 × 20 × 15 mm, walls as thin as possible, ignited before use (cl. 7.4.2); counterpoise bottle; desiccator.

reagents.name: Concentrated sulphuric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.84, as per IS 266-1950 (since revised) (cl. 7.3.1).

reagents.name: Chromic-sulphuric acid solution
reagents.prep: Saturate 100 ml of dilute sulphuric acid (2 : 1) with chromic anhydride (cl. 7.3.3).

reagents.name: Manganese sulphate
reagents.prep: Solid (cl. 7.3.4).

reagents.name: Ammonium persulphate solution
reagents.prep: 25 and 22.5 percent (w/v) (cl. 7.3.6).

reagents.name: Precipitated manganese dioxide
reagents.prep: (a) Dissolve 200 g of manganese sulphate (MnSO<sub>4</sub>.4H<sub>2</sub>O) in 2 500 ml of water. Add concentrated ammonium hydroxide until ammoniacal, then 1 000 ml of freshly prepared ammonium persulphate solution (22.5 percent), and heat to boiling. Boil for 10 minutes; add more concentrated ammonium hydroxide to keep it ammoniacal. More ammonium persulphate and ammonium hydroxide may be needed until precipitation is complete. (b) Stop boiling and let the precipitate settle. Wash by decantation 6 to 8 times with 500 to 600 ml portions of water, with full settling between washings. Last, wash 2 to 3 times by decantation with 500 to 600 ml portions of dilute sulphuric acid. Transfer to a Buchner funnel and wash with hot water until free from sulphates. Dry the residue at 105 to 110 °C, grind to pass IS Sieves 85 to 70 (aperture 842 to 708 microns) and dry again fully at 105 to 110 °C (cl. 7.3.7).

reagents.name: Soda asbestos
reagents.prep: Graded to IS Sieves 140 to 50 (aperture 1 405 to 500 microns) (cl. 7.3.8).

reagents.name: Anhydrone or magnesium perchlorate Mg(ClO<sub>4</sub>)<sub>2</sub>
reagents.prep: Keep the supply bottle well stoppered (cl. 7.3.9).

reagents.name: Lead foil
reagents.prep: Assay grade, 0.127 mm thick (cl. 7.3.10).

reagents.name: Magnesite brick powder
reagents.prep: Passed through IS Sieve 50 (aperture 500 microns), for spreading in the boat before combustion. Calcine in the open muffle furnace before use to remove any carbonaceous matter (cl. 7.3.11).

reagents.name: Low carbon standard steel of known carbon content
reagents.prep: 2.0 g mixed with the sample, and 2.0 g for the blank (cl. 7.4.2, 7.4.3).

en.sampling: Use 1 g of the sample (cl. 27.1.1); this replaces the 2.0 g of cl. 7.4.2.
procedure: Heat the furnace to a temperature between 1 200 to 1 300 °C (cl. 27.1.2; this replaces 1 250 to 1 350 °C of cl. 7.4.1).
Before starting, test the apparatus for leaks (cl. 7.4.1).
Pass a slow stream of oxygen through the whole train for about 15 minutes. Then weigh the carbon dioxide absorption tube. A counterpoise of a similar bottle is recommended.
Connect the tube back. Pass oxygen for 15 minutes and weigh again. If the weight is constant, the apparatus is ready for use.
Sprinkle some burnt magnesite brick dust (tested by the blank run) in the bottom of an ignited combustion boat (cl. 7.4.2).
Weigh 1 g of the sample (cl. 27.1.1). Mix it with 2.0 g of a low carbon standard steel of known carbon content and place it in the boat.
Cover the sample with lead foil (1.5 g, folded 2 times).
Push the boat quickly into the hot zone of the furnace. Put the rubber stopper back at the end of the combustion tube.
Wait about 1 minute so that the boat reaches the furnace temperature. Pass a rapid stream of oxygen (300 to 500 ml per minute) for 10 to 15 minutes to sweep out the carbon dioxide.
At the end of this time, remove the carbon dioxide absorption bulb. Cool it in a desiccator and weigh quickly against a similar tube used as counterpoise. The increase in weight is carbon dioxide.
Blank: carry out a blank on 2.0 g of the same low carbon standard steel that was mixed with the sample (cl. 7.4.3).
calculation: Carbon, percent = [(A - B) × 27.29] / C  (cl. 7.5)
where A = weight in g of carbon dioxide absorption tube after test, B = weight in g of carbon dioxide absorption tube in blank run, and C = weight in g of the sample taken.
en.reporting: Round off as per IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) (IS 1559 cl. 0.6).
notes: Section IV changes (cl. 27.1): 1 g of sample (cl. 27.1.1) and furnace temperature between 1 200 to 1 300 °C (cl. 27.1.2).
Alternate method: direct combustion volumetric method (cl. 28), see DM/QA/WI/31.

Quality of reagents (cl. 3.1): unless stated otherwise, use pure chemicals and distilled water [see IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)]. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that have no impurities which affect the results.
Filter papers (cl. 4.1): the IS gives Whatman filter paper numbers only. Any other suitable brand with the same porosity may also be used.

hi.title: Direct Combustion Gravimetric विधि द्वारा Silicomanganese में Carbon (Total) का निर्धारण
hi.purpose: Oxygen में direct combustion और बनी carbon dioxide को तौलकर silicomanganese में total carbon की मात्रा ज्ञात करना।

hi.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: C 2.0 percent Max।
hi.principle: (cl. 7.1) नमूने को शुद्ध oxygen की धारा में जलाएँ। Gas से contaminants हटाएँ। बनी carbon dioxide को soda asbestos में absorb करें। Absorbent के वजन में बढ़ोतरी carbon की मात्रा के अनुपात में होती है।
apparatus: Oxygen supply का स्रोत (Fig. 1): gas holder A (क्षमता 8 से 10 litres) जिसमें 99.5 percent oxygen हो, carbonaceous पदार्थ से मुक्त, rubber tubing से gas purifying train से जुड़ा। शुरू करने से पहले gas holder भर लें (cl. 7.2.1)।

Oxygen purification train: Arnold bottles (B) और (C), (C) में concentrated sulphuric acid, glass wool भरा exit bulb, और absorption bottle (D) जिसमें IS Sieve 140 से गुज़रने वाला पर IS Sieve 50 पर रुकने वाला soda asbestos और 'anhydrone' परतों में हो। ये gas holder और combustion tube के inlet के बीच series में जुड़े हों। ऊपर लगभग 12 mm anhydrone की परत नमी हटाती है और soda asbestos carbon dioxide हटाता है (cl. 7.2.2)।
Furnace: बिजली से 1 350 °C तक गर्म horizontal tube furnace (E) (cl. 7.2.3); silicomanganese के लिए 1 200 से 1 300 °C पर चलाएँ (cl. 27.1.2)।

Combustion tube: लगभग 650 mm लंबी, 20 mm भीतरी व्यास, fused silica, fireclay या अन्य उपयुक्त पदार्थ की। Ferric oxide रोकने के लिए exit सिरे में 75 mm लंबा ignited asbestos plug हल्के से रखें (cl. 7.2.4)।

Absorption train (cl. 7.2.5): back suction रोकने के लिए Arnold bottle (F); sulphur के oxides हटाने के लिए dilute sulphuric acid 2 : 1 (v/v) में chromic anhydride वाली gas absorption bottle (G); लगभग 40 ml concentrated sulphuric acid वाली bottle (H), exit सिरा glass wool से भरा; 'anhydrone' या अन्य उपयुक्त desiccant वाली tube (J); carbon dioxide absorption bottle (K) (80 ml क्षमता) जिसमें समान रूप से graded, बराबर भरा soda asbestos या ascarite और ऊपर anhydrone की परत हो, fillings को glass wool के छोटे plugs से रोका गया हो; इसी तरह भरी guard bottle (L), exit flowmeter से जुड़ा। Bottles (F), (G) और (H) के स्थान पर ignited asbestos पर precipitated manganese dioxide वाला Midvale या Nesbitt bulb (N) लगाया जा सकता है।
Porcelain, refractory clay, nickel sheet या alumina की combustion boat, लगभग 100 × 20 × 15 mm, दीवारें जितनी हो सके पतली, प्रयोग से पहले ignited (cl. 7.4.2); counterpoise bottle; desiccator।

reagents.name: Concentrated sulphuric acid

reagents.prep: 100 ml dilute sulphuric acid (2 : 1) को chromic anhydride से saturate करें (cl. 7.3.3)।

reagents.name: Ammonium persulphate solution
reagents.prep: 25 और 22.5 percent (w/v) (cl. 7.3.6)।

reagents.name: Precipitated manganese dioxide
reagents.prep: (a) 200 g manganese sulphate (MnSO<sub>4</sub>.4H<sub>2</sub>O) को 2 500 ml पानी में घोलें। Ammoniacal होने तक concentrated ammonium hydroxide डालें, फिर 1 000 ml ताज़ा बना ammonium persulphate solution (22.5 percent) डालें और उबाल तक गर्म करें। 10 मिनट उबालें; ammoniacal बनाए रखने के लिए और concentrated ammonium hydroxide डालें। Precipitation पूरा होने तक और ammonium persulphate व ammonium hydroxide की ज़रूरत हो सकती है। (b) उबालना बंद करें और precipitate बैठने दें। 500 से 600 ml पानी के हिस्सों से 6 से 8 बार decantation द्वारा धोएँ, हर बार पूरा बैठने दें। अंत में 500 से 600 ml dilute sulphuric acid के हिस्सों से 2 से 3 बार decantation द्वारा धोएँ। Buchner funnel में डालें और sulphate-मुक्त होने तक गर्म पानी से धोएँ। Residue को 105 से 110 °C पर सुखाएँ, IS Sieves 85 से 70 (aperture 842 से 708 microns) से गुज़रने लायक पीसें और फिर से 105 से 110 °C पर पूरा सुखाएँ (cl. 7.3.7)।

reagents.name: Soda asbestos
reagents.prep: IS Sieves 140 से 50 (aperture 1 405 से 500 microns) तक graded (cl. 7.3.8)।

reagents.name: Anhydrone या magnesium perchlorate Mg(ClO<sub>4</sub>)<sub>2</sub>
reagents.prep: Supply bottle अच्छी तरह बंद रखें (cl. 7.3.9)।

reagents.name: Lead foil
reagents.prep: Assay grade, 0.127 mm मोटी (cl. 7.3.10)।

reagents.name: Magnesite brick powder
reagents.prep: IS Sieve 50 (aperture 500 microns) से छना हुआ, combustion से पहले boat में फैलाने के लिए। किसी भी carbonaceous पदार्थ को हटाने के लिए प्रयोग से पहले खुली muffle furnace में calcine करें (cl. 7.3.11)।

reagents.name: ज्ञात carbon वाला low carbon standard steel
reagents.prep: 2.0 g नमूने के साथ मिलाने के लिए, और 2.0 g blank के लिए (cl. 7.4.2, 7.4.3)।

hi.sampling: 1 g नमूना प्रयोग करें (cl. 27.1.1); यह cl. 7.4.2 के 2.0 g के स्थान पर है।
procedure: Furnace को 1 200 से 1 300 °C के बीच के तापमान तक गर्म करें (cl. 27.1.2; यह cl. 7.4.1 के 1 250 से 1 350 °C के स्थान पर है)।
शुरू करने से पहले apparatus में leak की जाँच करें (cl. 7.4.1)।
पूरी train में लगभग 15 मिनट oxygen की धीमी धारा चलाएँ। फिर carbon dioxide absorption tube तौलें। इसी तरह की bottle को counterpoise के रूप में प्रयोग करने की सलाह है।
Tube को फिर से जोड़ें। 15 मिनट oxygen चलाएँ और फिर तौलें। वजन स्थिर हो तो apparatus प्रयोग के लिए तैयार है।
Ignited combustion boat के तले में थोड़ी burnt magnesite brick dust (blank run से जाँची हुई) छिड़कें (cl. 7.4.2)।
1 g नमूना तौलें (cl. 27.1.1)। इसे ज्ञात carbon वाले 2.0 g low carbon standard steel के साथ मिलाकर boat में रखें।
नमूने को lead foil (1.5 g, 2 बार मोड़ी हुई) से ढकें।
Boat को जल्दी से furnace के गर्म zone में डालें। Combustion tube के सिरे पर rubber stopper फिर से लगाएँ।
लगभग 1 मिनट रुकें ताकि boat furnace के तापमान पर आ जाए। Carbon dioxide बाहर निकालने के लिए 10 से 15 मिनट oxygen की तेज़ धारा (300 से 500 ml प्रति मिनट) चलाएँ।
इस समय के अंत में carbon dioxide absorption bulb निकालें। Desiccator में ठंडा करें और counterpoise वाली इसी तरह की tube के सामने जल्दी तौलें। वजन में बढ़ोतरी carbon dioxide है।
Blank: नमूने के साथ मिलाए गए उसी low carbon standard steel के 2.0 g पर blank करें (cl. 7.4.3)।
calculation: Carbon, percent = [(A - B) × 27.29] / C  (cl. 7.5)
जहाँ A = test के बाद carbon dioxide absorption tube का वजन g में, B = blank run में carbon dioxide absorption tube का वजन g में, और C = लिए गए नमूने का वजन g में।
hi.reporting: IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) के अनुसार round off करें (IS 1559 cl. 0.6)।
notes: Section IV बदलाव (cl. 27.1): 1 g नमूना (cl. 27.1.1) और furnace तापमान 1 200 से 1 300 °C के बीच (cl. 27.1.2)।
वैकल्पिक विधि: direct combustion volumetric विधि (cl. 28), देखें DM/QA/WI/31।

Reagents की गुणवत्ता (cl. 3.1): जब तक अलग न कहा जाए, pure chemicals और distilled water [देखें IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)] प्रयोग करें। 'Pure chemicals' का अर्थ है ऐसे chemicals जिनमें परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाली अशुद्धियाँ न हों।
Filter papers (cl. 4.1): IS में केवल Whatman filter paper के नंबर दिए गए हैं। समान porosity वाला कोई अन्य उपयुक्त brand भी प्रयोग किया जा सकता है।
Sampling (cl. 2.1): नमूने IS 1472 (Part I)-1959 के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें। Cl. 0.5 के अनुसार नवीनतम संस्करण लागू है: IS 1472 : 1977, देखें DM/QA/SOP/02।

en.title: Determination of Carbon (Total) in Silicomanganese by the Direct Combustion Volumetric (Alternate) Method
en.purpose: To find the total carbon content of silicomanganese by direct combustion in oxygen and gas-volumetric measurement of the carbon dioxide formed.
en.scope: This WI covers total carbon in silicomanganese by the direct combustion volumetric (alternate) method (IS 1559 cl. 28, with cl. 8). IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) covers the analysis of ferro-alloys, including silicomanganese of the composition ranges given in Appendix A.
en.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 28 (with 8 referred; 7.2.1, 7.2.4, 7.3.1, 7.3.11), Appendix A
en.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: C 2.0 percent Max.
en.principle: (cl. 8.1) Burn the sample in a stream of pure oxygen. After removal of contaminants, collect the carbon dioxide and excess oxygen in a specially jacketed burette. Absorb the carbon dioxide in alkali. Pass the excess oxygen back to the burette and read the decrease in volume on a scale calibrated directly in percent carbon.
apparatus: Source of oxygen supply (Fig. 2; cl. 8.2.1, same as 7.2.1): gas holder A (capacity 8 to 10 litres) containing 99.5 percent oxygen, free from carbonaceous matter, joined by rubber tubing to the gas purifying train. Fill the gas holder before starting.
Oxygen purification train: Arnold bottles (B) and (C) containing potassium hydroxide solution (30 percent) and concentrated sulphuric acid respectively (cl. 8.2.2).
Furnace: horizontal tube furnace (D) heated to 1 350 °C (cl. 8.2.3).

Combustion tube (cl. 8.2.4, same as 7.2.4): about 650 mm long, 20 mm inner diameter, of fused silica, fireclay or other suitable material; ignited asbestos plug 75 mm long placed lightly in the exit end to hold back ferric oxide.

Absorption train (cl. 8.2.5): 3-way stop-cock (E); bulbed tubing (F) filled with potassium permanganate crystals, exit end packed with glass wool; water-jacketed spiral cooling tube (G); bend-way manifold stop-cock (H), one end joined to the exit end of the combustion tube through (G), (F) and (E), the other two ends joined to the measuring burette (J) and the absorption pipette (K), so that (J) can be connected with (G) or with (K) as needed; levelling bottle (L) connected with the burette. The burette is graduated directly in percent carbon up to 1.5 percent for 1 g sample (cl. 8.4).
Boat of nickel, clay or porcelain, 75 × 15 × 15 mm (cl. 8.4).

reagents.name: Sodium or potassium hydroxide solution
reagents.prep: 30 percent (w/v) (cl. 8.3.1). Fill the absorption pipette (K) with it.

reagents.name: Concentrated sulphuric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.84, as per IS 266-1950 (since revised) (cl. 8.3.2; see 7.3.1).

reagents.name: Potassium permanganate
reagents.prep: Crystals (cl. 8.3.3).

reagents.name: Magnesite brick powder
reagents.prep: (cl. 8.3.4; see 7.3.11) Passed through IS Sieve 50 (aperture 500 microns). Calcine in the open muffle furnace before use to remove any carbonaceous matter.

reagents.name: Dilute sulphuric acid
reagents.prep: 2 : 98 (v/v) (cl. 8.3.5). For the burette, colour it with a few drops of methyl orange (cl. 8.2.5).

reagents.name: Standard steel of known carbon content
reagents.prep: For testing the apparatus (cl. 8.4.1).

en.sampling: Weigh accurately 1 g of the sample in the form of small drillings (cl. 8.4).
procedure: Before starting the combustion, work the stop-cocks (H) and (E) and the levelling bottle (L) to fill the measuring burette (J) with dilute sulphuric acid (2 : 98, coloured with methyl orange) and the absorption pipette (K) with sodium or potassium hydroxide solution (cl. 8.2.5).
Line a nickel, clay or porcelain boat (75 × 15 × 15 mm) thinly with burnt magnesite brick powder (cl. 8.4).
Weigh accurately 1 g of the sample, as small drillings, into the boat.
Put the boat into the heated combustion tube of the furnace (D), kept at 1 350 °C. Close the furnace inlet with a rubber stopper. Let the boat reach the furnace temperature.
Pass a stream of oxygen slowly into the furnace. Connect to the burette (already filled with acidulated water) so that the liquid level in the bulbed part of the gas burette does not fall fast.
After 1 minute or so the level in the burette starts to fall faster at the same oxygen flow. This shows the combustion is complete. Slow down the oxygen flow.
When the level reaches near the zero mark, close the bend-way stop-cock. Equalize the levels of the burette and the levelling bottle. Take the reading.
Pass the collected and measured gas several times into the absorption pipette until absorption of carbon dioxide is complete.
Measure the contraction in volume. After proper temperature and pressure corrections, it gives the percent carbon when 1 g of drillings is taken.
Use a standard steel of known carbon content to test the apparatus (cl. 8.4.1).
calculation: (cl. 8.4) The burette reads directly in percent carbon for 1 g of sample, after temperature and pressure corrections.
en.reporting: Round off as per IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) (IS 1559 cl. 0.6).
notes: Cl. 28.1 applies cl. 8 without any change (furnace 1 350 °C, 1 g sample).
The burette is graduated up to 1.5 percent carbon (cl. 8.4); Appendix A gives C up to 2.0 percent Max for silicomanganese.
Main method: direct combustion gravimetric method (cl. 27), see DM/QA/WI/30.

Quality of reagents (cl. 3.1): unless stated otherwise, use pure chemicals and distilled water [see IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)]. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that have no impurities which affect the results.
Sampling (cl. 2.1): draw and prepare samples as per IS 1472 (Part I)-1959. As per cl. 0.5 the latest version applies: IS 1472 : 1977, see DM/QA/SOP/02.

Furnace में oxygen की धारा धीरे-धीरे चलाएँ। Burette (पहले से acidulated water से भरी) से connection ऐसे बनाएँ कि gas burette के bulbed भाग में liquid level तेज़ी से न गिरे।
लगभग 1 मिनट बाद, oxygen का वही flow रहते हुए भी, burette में level तेज़ी से गिरने लगता है। इससे पता चलता है कि combustion पूरा हो गया। Oxygen का flow धीमा करें।
जब level zero mark के पास पहुँचे, bend-way stop-cock बंद करें। Burette और levelling bottle के levels बराबर करें। Reading लें।
इकट्ठा और मापी गई gas को कई बार absorption pipette में भेजें, जब तक carbon dioxide का absorption पूरा न हो जाए।
आयतन में कमी (contraction) मापें। उचित तापमान और दाब correction के बाद, 1 g drillings लेने पर यह percent carbon देता है।
Apparatus की जाँच के लिए ज्ञात carbon वाला standard steel प्रयोग करें (cl. 8.4.1)।
calculation: (cl. 8.4) तापमान और दाब correction के बाद, 1 g नमूने के लिए burette सीधे percent carbon पढ़ती है।
hi.reporting: IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) के अनुसार round off करें (IS 1559 cl. 0.6)।
notes: Cl. 28.1 के अनुसार cl. 8 बिना किसी बदलाव के लागू है (furnace 1 350 °C, 1 g नमूना)।
Burette 1.5 percent carbon तक graduated है (cl. 8.4); Appendix A में silicomanganese के लिए C 2.0 percent Max तक है।
मुख्य विधि: direct combustion gravimetric विधि (cl. 27), देखें DM/QA/WI/30।

Reagents की गुणवत्ता (cl. 3.1): जब तक अलग न कहा जाए, pure chemicals और distilled water [देखें IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)] प्रयोग करें। 'Pure chemicals' का अर्थ है ऐसे chemicals जिनमें परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाली अशुद्धियाँ न हों।
Sampling (cl. 2.1): नमूने IS 1472 (Part I)-1959 के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें। Cl. 0.5 के अनुसार नवीनतम संस्करण लागू है: IS 1472 : 1977, देखें DM/QA/SOP/02।

keywords: phosphorus p% silico manganese simn phosphorus in simn (alkalimetric)

en.title: Determination of Phosphorus in Silicomanganese by the Alkalimetric Method
en.purpose: To find the phosphorus content of silicomanganese by precipitation as ammonium phosphomolybdate and alkalimetric back-titration.
en.scope: This WI covers phosphorus in silicomanganese (IS 1559 cl. 29). IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) covers the analysis of ferro-alloys, including silicomanganese of the composition ranges given in Appendix A.
en.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 29 (with 23.2, 23.3.1, 23.3.2, 10.2, 10.3.2 to 10.4 referred), Appendix A
en.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: P 0.30 percent Max.
en.principle: (cl. 23.1) After removal of silica, phosphorus in the acid solution of the sample is precipitated as phosphomolybdate and then found in the usual way. (cl. 10.1) Ammonium phosphomolybdate is precipitated from the acid solution, filtered, and dissolved in excess sodium hydroxide solution. The unused alkali is back-titrated with standard hydrochloric acid.
apparatus: Filter paper No. 1 (cl. 10.2.10); filter paper pulp (cl. 10.3.4)

reagents.name: Concentrated nitric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.42, as per IS 264-1950 (since revised) (cl. 10.2.1; see 6.3.1).

reagents.name: Hydrofluoric acid
reagents.prep: 40 percent (cl. 10.2.2).

reagents.name: Sulphurous acid
reagents.prep: Saturate water with sulphur dioxide. Prepare fresh as needed (cl. 10.2.7).

reagents.name: Potassium permanganate solution
reagents.prep: 2.5 percent (w/v) (cl. 10.2.8).

reagents.name: Potassium nitrite
reagents.prep: Solid (cl. 10.2.9).

reagents.name: Ammonium molybdate solution
reagents.prep: Solution (A): dissolve 100 g of molybdic acid (MoO<sub>3</sub>, 85 percent) or 118 g of ammonium molybdate in a mixture of 145 ml of concentrated ammonium hydroxide and 270 ml of water; cool (cl. 10.2.10.1). Solution (B): add 490 ml of concentrated nitric acid to 1 150 ml of water and cool (cl. 10.2.10.2). Add solution (A) slowly, with constant stirring, to solution (B) kept cool in a cold water-bath. Add 10 ml of ammonium phosphate (1 g per litre). Keep the solution for at least 24 hours. Filter through filter paper No. 1 before use (cl. 10.2.10).

reagents.name: Concentrated sulphuric acid
reagents.prep: 'see 3.1' as printed in IS (cl. 10.2.11); cl. 7.3.1 gives sp gr 1.84.

reagents.name: Perchloric acid
reagents.prep: 70 percent (cl. 10.2.12).

reagents.name: Hydrobromic acid
reagents.prep: 48 percent (cl. 10.2.14).

reagents.name: Potassium nitrate wash solution
reagents.prep: 1 percent (w/v) (cl. 10.2.15).

reagents.name: Sodium hydroxide solution, 0.1 N
reagents.prep: Dissolve 4.5 g of purified sodium hydroxide in 1 litre of freshly boiled and cooled distilled water. Add a slight excess of barium hydroxide solution. Keep for 24 hours and decant the liquid before use (cl. 10.2.16).

reagents.name: Phenolphthalein indicator solution
reagents.prep: 0.2 percent (w/v) in rectified spirit (cl. 10.2.17).

reagents.name: Standard hydrochloric acid solution, 0.1 N
reagents.prep: Dilute 11 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid to 1 litre. Standardize against sodium carbonate (cl. 10.2.18).

reagents.name: Ammonium bromide
reagents.prep: 5 g used in cl. 10.3.2; not listed in cl. 10.2.

en.sampling: Weigh accurately the sample mass given in the table below, as per the phosphorus content (cl. 23.3.1).
procedure: Weigh accurately the sample as per the table, based on the phosphorus percent (cl. 23.3.1).
Transfer the sample to a large platinum dish with a cover. Add 50 ml of concentrated nitric acid. Then add 10 to 15 ml of hydrofluoric acid in small amounts (cl. 29.1.1).
Digest until dissolved. Evaporate to dryness and bake for 20 minutes at about 150 °C (cl. 23.3.1).
Cool. Take up the mass in 20 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid and boil until the solution is clear.
Dilute with 20 ml of water. Filter into a 400-ml beaker. Wash the paper and residue with small amounts of dilute hydrochloric acid. Keep the filtrate.
Ignite the paper and residue in a platinum crucible. Add 5 ml of concentrated sulphuric acid and 5 ml of hydrofluoric acid. Evaporate to dense white fumes (cl. 23.3.2).
Cool. Dilute carefully with 5 ml of water. Add this solution to the filtrate from step e. Wash the crucible with water.
Add 5 g of ammonium bromide. Remove the beaker cover and evaporate until white fumes appear and the volume is reduced to 4 ml (cl. 10.3.2).
Add 10 ml of concentrated nitric acid. Warm gently until all bromine is driven out.
Dilute with 40 ml of water. Heat to boiling and oxidize with potassium permanganate solution.
Dissolve the precipitated manganese again with a few drops of potassium nitrite solution. Boil well and cool.
Add concentrated ammonium hydroxide in slight excess. Just dissolve the precipitate again by careful addition of 4 to 5 ml of concentrated nitric acid. Then add 4 ml in excess (cl. 10.3.3).
Bring the solution to 70 to 80 °C. Add 40 ml of filtered ammonium molybdate solution. Shake until the precipitate forms. Let it stand for 1 hour.
Filter the yellow ammonium phosphomolybdate precipitate through filter paper pulp. Wash with cold dilute nitric acid (2 : 98) (cl. 10.3.4).

Wash 3 to 4 times with cold dilute nitric acid (1 : 99). Wash with potassium nitrate wash solution until 10 ml of filtrate, collected in a test tube, does not use more than 1 drop of the alkali solution with phenolphthalein indicator. This shows the filtrate is free from acid (cl. 10.3.5).
Transfer the filter paper pulp with the precipitate to the beaker used for the precipitation.
Add, with stirring, a measured excess of sodium hydroxide solution until all the yellow precipitate dissolves and the solution is colourless.
Add 50 to 60 ml of water and about 5 ml of sodium hydroxide solution in excess. Stir.
Add 3 to 4 drops of phenolphthalein indicator solution. Titrate with the standard hydrochloric acid solution until the pink colour is fully discharged.
Blank: titrate the same quantity of sodium hydroxide solution as added in the test with the standard hydrochloric acid solution, using 3 to 4 drops of phenolphthalein indicator solution (cl. 10.3.6).
en.end_point: Pink colour fully discharged (cl. 10.3.5).

tables.title: Weight of sample (cl. 23.3.1)

calculation: Phosphorus, percent = [(A - B) × C × 0.135] / D  (cl. 10.4)
where A = volume in ml of the standard hydrochloric acid solution needed for the blank test,
B = volume in ml of the standard hydrochloric acid solution needed to titrate the excess,
C = normality of the standard hydrochloric acid solution, and D = weight in g of the sample taken.
en.reporting: Round off as per IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) (IS 1559 cl. 0.6).
notes: Cl. 29.1 as printed says 'following the procedure as given under 22'. Cl. 22 is sulphur (ferromanganese); phosphorus is cl. 23, and cl. 29.1.1 itself says to complete the test 'as under 23.3.1 and 23.3.2'. This WI follows cl. 23 (23.2 reagents = 10.2).

Section IV change (cl. 29.1.1): dissolve in a large platinum dish with 50 ml concentrated nitric acid and 10 to 15 ml hydrofluoric acid, in place of the 400-ml beaker / 15 ml HNO<sub>3</sub> + 10 ml HCl dissolution of cl. 23.3.1.
Table of cl. 23.3.1: row 3 reads '1' (percent) as printed in IS; there is no entry for 0.60 to 1 percent.
In cl. 10.3.5 the dilute nitric acid ratio is partly unreadable in the scan; read as (1 : 99), in line with cl. 10.2.6.

Quality of reagents (cl. 3.1): unless stated otherwise, use pure chemicals and distilled water [see IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)]. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that have no impurities which affect the results.
Filter papers (cl. 4.1): the IS gives Whatman filter paper numbers only. Any other suitable brand with the same porosity may also be used.
Sampling (cl. 2.1): draw and prepare samples as per IS 1472 (Part I)-1959. As per cl. 0.5 the latest version applies: IS 1472 : 1977, see DM/QA/SOP/02.

hi.title: Alkalimetric विधि द्वारा Silicomanganese में Phosphorus का निर्धारण
hi.purpose: Ammonium phosphomolybdate के रूप में precipitation और alkalimetric back-titration द्वारा silicomanganese में phosphorus की मात्रा ज्ञात करना।
hi.scope: यह WI silicomanganese में phosphorus के लिए है (IS 1559 cl. 29)। IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) ferro-alloys के विश्लेषण के लिए है, जिसमें Appendix A में दी गई संरचना-सीमा वाला silicomanganese भी शामिल है।
hi.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 29 (with 23.2, 23.3.1, 23.3.2, 10.2, 10.3.2 to 10.4 referred), Appendix A
hi.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: P 0.30 percent Max।
hi.principle: (cl. 23.1) Silica हटाने के बाद नमूने के acid solution में phosphorus को phosphomolybdate के रूप में precipitate करके सामान्य तरीके से ज्ञात किया जाता है। (cl. 10.1) Acid solution से ammonium phosphomolybdate precipitate करके filter किया जाता है और अधिक sodium hydroxide solution में घोला जाता है। बचे हुए alkali को standard hydrochloric acid से back-titrate किया जाता है।
apparatus: Filter paper No. 1 (cl. 10.2.10); filter paper pulp (cl. 10.3.4)

reagents.name: Concentrated nitric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.42, IS 264-1950 (since revised) के अनुसार (cl. 10.2.1; देखें 6.3.1)।

reagents.name: Hydrofluoric acid
reagents.prep: 40 percent (cl. 10.2.2)।

reagents.name: Sulphurous acid
reagents.prep: पानी को sulphur dioxide से saturate करें। ज़रूरत के अनुसार ताज़ा बनाएँ (cl. 10.2.7)।

reagents.name: Potassium permanganate solution
reagents.prep: 2.5 percent (w/v) (cl. 10.2.8)।

reagents.name: Ammonium molybdate solution
reagents.prep: Solution (A): 100 g molybdic acid (MoO<sub>3</sub>, 85 percent) या 118 g ammonium molybdate को 145 ml concentrated ammonium hydroxide और 270 ml पानी के मिश्रण में घोलें; ठंडा करें (cl. 10.2.10.1)। Solution (B): 490 ml concentrated nitric acid को 1 150 ml पानी में डालें और ठंडा करें (cl. 10.2.10.2)। Solution (A) को धीरे-धीरे, लगातार हिलाते हुए, ठंडे water-bath में रखे solution (B) में डालें। 10 ml ammonium phosphate (1 g प्रति litre) डालें। Solution को कम से कम 24 घंटे रखें। प्रयोग से पहले filter paper No. 1 से filter करें (cl. 10.2.10)।

reagents.name: Perchloric acid
reagents.prep: 70 percent (cl. 10.2.12)।

reagents.name: Hydrobromic acid
reagents.prep: 48 percent (cl. 10.2.14)।

reagents.name: Potassium nitrate wash solution
reagents.prep: 1 percent (w/v) (cl. 10.2.15)।

reagents.name: Sodium hydroxide solution, 0.1 N
reagents.prep: 4.5 g purified sodium hydroxide को 1 litre ताज़ा उबले और ठंडे distilled water में घोलें। Barium hydroxide solution थोड़ा अधिक डालें। 24 घंटे रखें और प्रयोग से पहले liquid को decant करें (cl. 10.2.16)।

reagents.name: Phenolphthalein indicator solution
reagents.prep: Rectified spirit में 0.2 percent (w/v) (cl. 10.2.17)।

reagents.prep: 11 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid को 1 litre तक dilute करें। Sodium carbonate से standardize करें (cl. 10.2.18)।

reagents.name: Ammonium bromide
reagents.prep: Cl. 10.3.2 में 5 g प्रयोग होता है; cl. 10.2 में सूचीबद्ध नहीं है।

hi.sampling: Phosphorus की मात्रा के अनुसार नीचे की तालिका में दिया नमूना सही-सही तौलें (cl. 23.3.1)।
procedure: Phosphorus percent के अनुसार तालिका से नमूना सही-सही तौलें (cl. 23.3.1)।
नमूने को ढक्कन सहित बड़ी platinum dish में डालें। 50 ml concentrated nitric acid डालें। फिर 10 से 15 ml hydrofluoric acid थोड़ा-थोड़ा करके डालें (cl. 29.1.1)।
घुलने तक digest करें। सूखने तक evaporate करें और लगभग 150 °C पर 20 मिनट bake करें (cl. 23.3.1)।
ठंडा करें। Mass को 20 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid में लें और साफ़ solution बनने तक उबालें।
20 ml पानी से dilute करें। 400-ml beaker में filter करें। Paper और residue को dilute hydrochloric acid की थोड़ी मात्रा से धोएँ। Filtrate रख लें।
Paper और residue को platinum crucible में ignite करें। 5 ml concentrated sulphuric acid और 5 ml hydrofluoric acid डालें। घने सफ़ेद fumes तक evaporate करें (cl. 23.3.2)।
ठंडा करें। सावधानी से 5 ml पानी से dilute करें। इस solution को step e के filtrate में मिलाएँ। Crucible को पानी से धोएँ।
5 g ammonium bromide डालें। Beaker का ढक्कन हटाकर तब तक evaporate करें जब तक सफ़ेद fumes आएँ और आयतन 4 ml रह जाए (cl. 10.3.2)।
10 ml concentrated nitric acid डालें। सारा bromine निकलने तक हल्का गर्म करें।
40 ml पानी से dilute करें। उबाल तक गर्म करें और potassium permanganate solution से oxidize करें।
Precipitate हुए manganese को potassium nitrite solution की कुछ बूँदों से फिर घोलें। अच्छी तरह उबालें और ठंडा करें।
Concentrated ammonium hydroxide थोड़ा अधिक डालें। 4 से 5 ml concentrated nitric acid सावधानी से डालकर precipitate को बस घोल दें। फिर 4 ml अधिक डालें (cl. 10.3.3)।
Solution का तापमान 70 से 80 °C करें। 40 ml filtered ammonium molybdate solution डालें। Precipitate बनने तक हिलाएँ। 1 घंटा रखा रहने दें।
पीले ammonium phosphomolybdate precipitate को filter paper pulp से filter करें। ठंडे dilute nitric acid (2 : 98) से धोएँ (cl. 10.3.4)।

ठंडे dilute nitric acid (1 : 99) से 3 से 4 बार धोएँ। Potassium nitrate wash solution से तब तक धोएँ जब तक test tube में लिया गया 10 ml filtrate, phenolphthalein indicator के साथ, alkali solution की 1 बूँद से अधिक न ले। इससे पता चलता है कि filtrate acid-मुक्त है (cl. 10.3.5)।
Filter paper pulp को precipitate सहित उसी beaker में डालें जिसमें precipitation किया था।
हिलाते हुए sodium hydroxide solution की मापी हुई अधिक मात्रा तब तक डालें जब तक सारा पीला precipitate घुल न जाए और solution रंगहीन न हो जाए।
50 से 60 ml पानी और लगभग 5 ml sodium hydroxide solution अधिक डालें। हिलाएँ।
3 से 4 बूँद phenolphthalein indicator solution डालें। Standard hydrochloric acid solution से गुलाबी रंग पूरी तरह ग़ायब होने तक titrate करें।
Blank: test में डाले गए उतने ही sodium hydroxide solution को 3 से 4 बूँद phenolphthalein indicator solution के साथ standard hydrochloric acid solution से titrate करें (cl. 10.3.6)।
hi.end_point: गुलाबी रंग पूरी तरह ग़ायब (cl. 10.3.5)।

tables.title: नमूने का वजन (Weight of sample) (cl. 23.3.1)

calculation: Phosphorus, percent = [(A - B) × C × 0.135] / D  (cl. 10.4)
जहाँ A = blank test के लिए लगा standard hydrochloric acid solution, ml में,
B = अधिक (excess) को titrate करने में लगा standard hydrochloric acid solution, ml में,
C = standard hydrochloric acid solution की normality, और D = लिए गए नमूने का वजन g में।
hi.reporting: IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) के अनुसार round off करें (IS 1559 cl. 0.6)।
notes: Cl. 29.1 में छपा है 'following the procedure as given under 22'। Cl. 22 sulphur (ferromanganese) है; phosphorus cl. 23 है, और cl. 29.1.1 स्वयं test को 'as under 23.3.1 and 23.3.2' पूरा करने को कहता है। यह WI cl. 23 का पालन करता है (23.2 reagents = 10.2)।

Section IV बदलाव (cl. 29.1.1): cl. 23.3.1 के 400-ml beaker / 15 ml HNO<sub>3</sub> + 10 ml HCl dissolution के स्थान पर बड़ी platinum dish में 50 ml concentrated nitric acid और 10 से 15 ml hydrofluoric acid से घोलें।
Cl. 23.3.1 की तालिका: पंक्ति 3 में IS में '1' (percent) छपा है; 0.60 से 1 percent के लिए कोई entry नहीं है।
Cl. 10.3.5 में dilute nitric acid का अनुपात scan में आंशिक रूप से अपठनीय है; cl. 10.2.6 के अनुसार (1 : 99) पढ़ा गया है।

Reagents की गुणवत्ता (cl. 3.1): जब तक अलग न कहा जाए, pure chemicals और distilled water [देखें IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)] प्रयोग करें। 'Pure chemicals' का अर्थ है ऐसे chemicals जिनमें परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाली अशुद्धियाँ न हों।
Filter papers (cl. 4.1): IS में केवल Whatman filter paper के नंबर दिए गए हैं। समान porosity वाला कोई अन्य उपयुक्त brand भी प्रयोग किया जा सकता है।
Sampling (cl. 2.1): नमूने IS 1472 (Part I)-1959 के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें। Cl. 0.5 के अनुसार नवीनतम संस्करण लागू है: IS 1472 : 1977, देखें DM/QA/SOP/02।

en.title: Determination of Sulphur in Silicomanganese by the Gravimetric Method
en.purpose: To find the sulphur content of silicomanganese by precipitation as barium sulphate.
en.scope: This WI covers sulphur in silicomanganese (IS 1559 cl. 30). IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) covers the analysis of ferro-alloys, including silicomanganese of the composition ranges given in Appendix A.
en.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 30 (with 9 referred), Appendix A
en.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: S 0.03 percent Max.
en.principle: (cl. 9.1) Remove silica and reduce ferric iron to the ferrous state with zinc. Then precipitate sulphur as barium sulphate with barium chloride in acid medium.
apparatus: Close texture filter paper; filter paper No. 42 (cl. 9.3.2, 9.3.3)

reagents.name: Concentrated nitric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.42, as per IS 264-1950 (since revised) (cl. 9.2.1; see 6.3.1).

reagents.name: Hydrofluoric acid
reagents.prep: 40 percent (cl. 9.2.2).

reagents.name: Potassium nitrate
reagents.prep: Crystals (cl. 9.2.3).

reagents.name: Boric acid
reagents.prep: Saturated solution (cl. 9.2.4).

reagents.name: Concentrated hydrochloric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.16, as per IS 265-1950 (since revised) (cl. 9.2.5; see 5.3.3).

reagents.name: Zinc
reagents.prep: 20 to 30 mesh powder, sulphur-free (cl. 9.2.6).

reagents.name: Barium chloride solution
reagents.prep: 10 percent (w/v) (cl. 9.2.8).

reagents.name: Hydrochloric acid wash solution
reagents.prep: Dilute 5 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid with water to 1 000 ml. Add 1 g of barium chloride (cl. 9.2.9).

en.sampling: 5 g of sample, ground to pass IS Sieve 15, weighed accurately (cl. 9.3.1).
procedure: Grind the sample to pass IS Sieve 15. Weigh accurately 5 g into a 300-ml platinum dish with a cover (cl. 9.3.1).
Add 50 to 60 ml of concentrated nitric acid, then 1 to 2 ml of hydrofluoric acid. Warm, if needed, to start the reaction.
Stop heating once the attack starts. Add small portions of hydrofluoric acid from time to time until decomposition is complete (usually 50 to 60 ml of hydrofluoric acid is needed).
Add 2 g of potassium nitrate. Evaporate to a small volume (3 to 5 ml).
Add 10 to 15 ml of concentrated nitric acid. Evaporate again to a small volume, to remove all hydrofluoric acid.
Add 25 ml of boric acid solution. Digest for 15 minutes at about 90 °C.
Transfer the solution to a porcelain vessel. Evaporate to dryness and bake at 120 °C.
Dissolve the residue in 50 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid and evaporate to dryness again. Treat with 30 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid.
Evaporate to a syrupy consistency. Add 5 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid, 50 ml of hot water and 5 g of zinc (cl. 9.3.2).
Warm on a steam-bath until iron is reduced to the ferrous state and hydrogen stops coming out.
Filter through a close texture filter paper. Wash 3 to 4 times with hot dilute hydrochloric acid.
Concentrate the filtrate to bring the acidity to 2 percent by volume of hydrochloric acid (cl. 9.3.3).
Warm to 60 to 70 °C. Add 10 ml of barium chloride solution drop by drop with constant stirring.
Keep the solution for 2 hours on the steam-bath and then overnight at room temperature.
Filter through filter paper No. 42. Wash the precipitate out of the beaker with a jet of cold hydrochloric acid wash solution.
Wash until the filtrate is free from iron salts. Then wash with cold water until chlorides are removed.
Transfer the pad and precipitate to a platinum or porcelain crucible.
Dry the filter pad fully at a low temperature (in the mouth of a muffle furnace) until the paper chars and burns gently (cl. 9.3.4).
Ignite finally at 800 to 900 °C to constant weight. Weigh the barium sulphate.
Blank: carry out a blank with the same procedure and the same quantity of all reagents, but without the sample (cl. 9.3.5).
calculation: Sulphur, percent = [(A - B) × 13.74] / C  (cl. 9.4)
where A = weight in g of the barium sulphate obtained in 9.3.4, B = weight in g of barium sulphate obtained in the blank determination, and C = weight in g of the sample taken.
en.reporting: Round off as per IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) (IS 1559 cl. 0.6).
notes: Cl. 30.1 applies the ferrosilicon procedure of cl. 9 to silicomanganese without change (sample mass 5 g as in cl. 9.3.1).

Quality of reagents (cl. 3.1): unless stated otherwise, use pure chemicals and distilled water [see IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)]. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that have no impurities which affect the results.
Filter papers (cl. 4.1): the IS gives Whatman filter paper numbers only. Any other suitable brand with the same porosity may also be used.
Sampling (cl. 2.1): draw and prepare samples as per IS 1472 (Part I)-1959. As per cl. 0.5 the latest version applies: IS 1472 : 1977, see DM/QA/SOP/02.

hi.title: Gravimetric विधि द्वारा Silicomanganese में Sulphur का निर्धारण
hi.purpose: Barium sulphate के रूप में precipitation द्वारा silicomanganese में sulphur की मात्रा ज्ञात करना।
hi.scope: यह WI silicomanganese में sulphur के लिए है (IS 1559 cl. 30)। IS 1559 (cl. 1.1) ferro-alloys के विश्लेषण के लिए है, जिसमें Appendix A में दी गई संरचना-सीमा वाला silicomanganese भी शामिल है।
hi.reference: IS 1559 : 1961 (Reaffirmed 2023) Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferro-Alloys, Section IV Silicomanganese, Clauses 1 to 4, 30 (with 9 referred), Appendix A
hi.range: Appendix A, silicomanganese: S 0.03 percent Max।
hi.principle: (cl. 9.1) Silica हटाएँ और zinc से ferric iron को ferrous अवस्था में reduce करें। फिर acid माध्यम में barium chloride से sulphur को barium sulphate के रूप में precipitate करें।
apparatus: Close texture filter paper; filter paper No. 42 (cl. 9.3.2, 9.3.3)

reagents.name: Concentrated nitric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.42, IS 264-1950 (since revised) के अनुसार (cl. 9.2.1; देखें 6.3.1)।

reagents.name: Hydrofluoric acid
reagents.prep: 40 percent (cl. 9.2.2)।

reagents.name: Potassium nitrate
reagents.prep: Crystals (cl. 9.2.3)।

reagents.name: Boric acid
reagents.prep: Saturated solution (cl. 9.2.4)।

reagents.name: Concentrated hydrochloric acid
reagents.prep: sp gr 1.16, IS 265-1950 (since revised) के अनुसार (cl. 9.2.5; देखें 5.3.3)।

reagents.name: Zinc
reagents.prep: 20 से 30 mesh powder, sulphur-मुक्त (cl. 9.2.6)।

reagents.name: Barium chloride solution
reagents.prep: 10 percent (w/v) (cl. 9.2.8)।

reagents.name: Hydrochloric acid wash solution
reagents.prep: 5 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid को पानी से 1 000 ml तक dilute करें। 1 g barium chloride डालें (cl. 9.2.9)।

hi.sampling: IS Sieve 15 से गुज़रने लायक पिसा हुआ 5 g नमूना, सही-सही तौला हुआ (cl. 9.3.1)।
procedure: नमूने को IS Sieve 15 से गुज़रने लायक पीसें। 5 g सही-सही तौलकर ढक्कन सहित 300-ml platinum dish में डालें (cl. 9.3.1)।
50 से 60 ml concentrated nitric acid डालें, फिर 1 से 2 ml hydrofluoric acid डालें। ज़रूरत हो तो reaction शुरू करने के लिए गर्म करें।
Attack शुरू होते ही गर्म करना बंद करें। Decomposition पूरा होने तक समय-समय पर hydrofluoric acid थोड़ा-थोड़ा डालें (आमतौर पर 50 से 60 ml hydrofluoric acid लगता है)।
2 g potassium nitrate डालें। कम आयतन (3 से 5 ml) तक evaporate करें।
10 से 15 ml concentrated nitric acid डालें। सारा hydrofluoric acid हटाने के लिए फिर से कम आयतन तक evaporate करें।
25 ml boric acid solution डालें। लगभग 90 °C पर 15 मिनट digest करें।
Solution को porcelain पात्र में डालें। सूखने तक evaporate करें और 120 °C पर bake करें।
Residue को 50 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid में घोलें और फिर सूखने तक evaporate करें। 30 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid से treat करें।
Syrupy होने तक evaporate करें। 5 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid, 50 ml गर्म पानी और 5 g zinc डालें (cl. 9.3.2)।
Steam-bath पर तब तक गर्म करें जब तक iron ferrous अवस्था में reduce न हो जाए और hydrogen निकलना बंद न हो जाए।
Close texture filter paper से filter करें। गर्म dilute hydrochloric acid से 3 से 4 बार धोएँ।
Filtrate को गाढ़ा करके acidity को hydrochloric acid के 2 percent (आयतन से) पर लाएँ (cl. 9.3.3)।
60 से 70 °C तक गर्म करें। लगातार हिलाते हुए 10 ml barium chloride solution बूँद-बूँद डालें।
Solution को 2 घंटे steam-bath पर और फिर रात भर कमरे के तापमान पर रखें।
Filter paper No. 42 से filter करें। ठंडे hydrochloric acid wash solution की धार से beaker से precipitate निकालें।
Filtrate के iron salts से मुक्त होने तक धोएँ। फिर chlorides हटने तक ठंडे पानी से धोएँ।
Pad और precipitate को platinum या porcelain crucible में डालें।
Filter pad को कम तापमान पर (muffle furnace के मुँह पर) पूरा सुखाएँ जब तक paper जलकर काला न हो और धीरे से न जले (cl. 9.3.4)।
अंत में 800 से 900 °C पर constant weight तक ignite करें। Barium sulphate तौलें।
Blank: नमूने के बिना, उसी विधि और सभी reagents की उतनी ही मात्रा से blank करें (cl. 9.3.5)।
calculation: Sulphur, percent = [(A - B) × 13.74] / C  (cl. 9.4)
जहाँ A = 9.3.4 में प्राप्त barium sulphate का वजन g में, B = blank determination में प्राप्त barium sulphate का वजन g में, और C = लिए गए नमूने का वजन g में।
hi.reporting: IS 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised) के अनुसार round off करें (IS 1559 cl. 0.6)।
notes: Cl. 30.1 के अनुसार cl. 9 की ferrosilicon विधि silicomanganese पर बिना बदलाव लागू है (नमूना 5 g, cl. 9.3.1 के अनुसार)।

Reagents की गुणवत्ता (cl. 3.1): जब तक अलग न कहा जाए, pure chemicals और distilled water [देखें IS 1070-1960 Water, Distilled Quality (Revised)] प्रयोग करें। 'Pure chemicals' का अर्थ है ऐसे chemicals जिनमें परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाली अशुद्धियाँ न हों।
Filter papers (cl. 4.1): IS में केवल Whatman filter paper के नंबर दिए गए हैं। समान porosity वाला कोई अन्य उपयुक्त brand भी प्रयोग किया जा सकता है।
Sampling (cl. 2.1): नमूने IS 1472 (Part I)-1959 के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें। Cl. 0.5 के अनुसार नवीनतम संस्करण लागू है: IS 1472 : 1977, देखें DM/QA/SOP/02।

en.title: Sampling of Refractory Plastic and Ramming Mass (Lot, Sample Size, Reduction and Conformity)
en.purpose: To draw and reduce a representative sample from a lot of refractory ramming mass / plastic for physical tests and chemical analysis.
en.scope: IS 10047 : 2023 gives the methods of sampling and tests of refractory plastic and ramming mass (1.1). It does not cover sampling and tests of dry vibratable masses (1.2). Dry mix or dry vibratable refractory: unshaped refractory made to be placed in the dry state by vibration or ramming (3.4). IS 1528 (Part 7) : 2010 gives the methods of sampling and criteria for conformity for refractory raw materials, finished shaped refractories, mortars and monolithics (excluding refractory castables) (1).
en.reference: IS 10047 : 2023 (First Revision), Clauses 1, 3, 4, 5.1, 7 (7.2.1, 7.3, 7.4, 7.5); IS 1528 (Part 7) : 2010 (Second Revision, Reaffirmed 2020), Clauses 1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5 (4.5.1, 4.5.2), 4.6.2.2, 5.2.1 to 5.2.10, and Amendment No. 1 (December 2022), Clauses 5.2.11 and 5.2.12
en.principle: All containers/bags of the same type and grade, from the same manufacturer, made under similar production conditions, form a lot (max. 50 tonnes) (IS 10047, 4.1; IS 1528 Part 7, 4.5.1). Bags are selected at random as per Table 1 of IS 10047 to give a minimum of about 50 kg. The material is mixed and reduced by coning and quartering into test samples. The lot is judged against the specification by the criteria for conformity of IS 10047, 7.4 and IS 1528 (Part 7), 5.2.
apparatus: Suitable dry surface / dry floor for emptying the bags (7.2.1, 7.3)
Shovel or any other suitable tool for mixing (7.3)
Balance — laboratory balance, 10 kg capacity with ± 0.1 g accuracy (7.1 c)
en.sampling:
Lot (IS 10047, 4.1): In any consignment, group together all containers/bags of refractory plastic/ramming mass of the same type and grade, made by the same manufacturer under similar production conditions. This forms a lot. The maximum mass of a lot is 50 tonnes.
Lot (IS 1528 Part 7, 4.5.1): In any consignment, group together all containers/bags of refractory mortar or monolithics of the same type and grade, made by the same firm under similar production conditions. This forms a lot. The maximum weight of a lot is 50 tonnes.
Sample size (IS 10047, 4.2): About 50 kg minimum sample is needed to complete all the tests. The material is normally supplied in 50 kg containers/bags, so select the number of containers/bags at random as given in Table 1.
Number and weight of samples (IS 1528 Part 7, 4.5.2): From each lot, select three containers/bags at random over the whole lot. From each selected container/bag, after thorough mixing and coning and quartering, collect about 1 kg material for the tests for pyrometric cone equivalent, moisture content, sieve analysis and chemical analysis. If the lot has less than three containers, collect 1 kg material from each container (Note to 4.5.2).
procedure: Group the containers/bags of one consignment into lots as per 4.1 (same type and grade, same manufacturer, similar production conditions; maximum 50 tonnes per lot).
From each lot, select at random the number of 50 kg containers/bags given in Table 1 (4.2).

If the manufacturer's test results are not available to the purchaser, or the supply has material from different kilns, or the supplier is unknown or new, the procedure of IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.5 may be followed (IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.2 and 4.3).

IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.5.2: Select three containers/bags at random over the whole lot (if the lot has less than three containers, take every container). From each selected container/bag, mix well, cone and quarter, and collect about 1 kg material for pyrometric cone equivalent, moisture content, sieve analysis and chemical analysis.
Dry ramming mass (7.2.1): Empty the selected containers/bags on a suitable dry surface. Mix the material well.
Reduce the mixed mass to 50 kg by coning and quartering (7.2.1).
Divide this final sample equally into five test samples by repeated coning and quartering (7.2.1).
Plastic and wet ramming mass (7.3): Discharge the selected containers/bags/batches on a dry floor. For plastic refractories, collect bags at random as per Table 1.

For wet ramming mass, empty the selected containers/bags on a suitable dry surface so that the material does not get contaminated. Mix with a shovel or any other suitable tool. Collect the needed quantity from different places of the heap, as agreed between the purchaser and the supplier (7.3).
For shaping test pieces, reduce the material with the riffle (quartering – coning) sampler. The batch size depends on the number of test pieces needed (7.5).

Use the collected samples for the physical tests and chemical analysis listed in 4.3: a) Pyrometric cone equivalent (PCE); b) Apparent porosity; c) Bulk density (BD); d) Permanent linear change (PLC); e) Cold crushing strength (CCS); f) Thermal conductivity; g) Hot modulus of rupture (HMOR).

Sample for chemical analysis (5.1): Do chemical analysis of the ramming specimen on loss free basis. Grind the 50 mm × 50 mm cylindrical test specimen (prepared as per clause 7) to 104 microns for gravimetric analysis or to 45 microns for instrumental analysis.
Make sure the bulk density (BD) of the selected specimen is within the ranges agreed between the purchaser and the supplier (5.1).

en.reporting:
Conformity (IS 10047 : 2023, 7.4): All test specimens tested for the physical and chemical characteristics must meet the matching requirements for the lot to be accepted.
Criteria for conformity (IS 1528 (Part 7) : 2010, 5.2):
5.2.1 Criteria for apparent porosity and cold crushing strength: as agreed between the purchaser and the manufacturer.
5.2.2 The lot conforms to the requirements of true specific gravity, true density and bulk density if: a) Number of samples tested — Three (5 for bulk density); and b) Criteria — If all individual results are satisfactory, accept the lot. But if one result is: 1) when a maximum limit is given, not more than 0.01 above the specified maximum, accept the lot if the average of all results is equal to or less than the maximum limit; 2) when a minimum limit is given, below the specified minimum by not more than 0.01, accept the lot if the average of all results is equal to or more than the minimum limit.
5.2.3 The lot conforms to the requirements of permanent linear change if: a) Number of samples tested — Five; and b) Criteria — If all individual results are satisfactory, accept the lot. But if one test result is not more than 10 percent of the specified maximum, declare the lot as conforming if the average of all test results is equal to or less than the maximum limit.
5.2.4 The lot conforms to the pyrometric cone equivalent requirement if both test results meet the specification.
5.2.5 The lot conforms to the chemical requirements of the material specification if the results for each chemical characteristic, tested as per IS 12107, IS 1527, IS 1760 (Parts 1 to 6) and IS 12667 (sentence incomplete as printed in IS). Chemical composition of material not covered by these standards: as agreed between the purchaser and the manufacturer. (Note: XRF can also be used if agreed between the purchaser and the manufacturer.)
5.2.6 The lot conforms to the requirements of refractoriness under load and spalling resistance if the specimens tested meet the specification.
5.2.7 For spalling resistance and resistance to carbon monoxide, the results of each test piece must meet the specification.
5.2.8 The lot conforms to the sieve analysis requirement if the sieved sample meets the specification.
5.2.9 Round off the results as per IS 2 before judging conformity.
5.2.10 If any one property does not conform, re-test only that property, if agreed between the purchaser and the manufacturer. If all retest results conform, accept the lot.
5.2.11 (Amendment No. 1, Dec 2022) The lot conforms to the Modulus of Rupture requirement if the average of all test results meets the requirement and the individual results do not differ by more than 20 percent (with reference to the highest value obtained).
5.2.12 (Amendment No. 1, Dec 2022) Criteria for all other tests not given in clause no. 4.6.2.2: as agreed between the purchaser and the manufacturer.
notes: The same test sample may be used for more than one test, if the test methods allow. For example, bulk density, permanent linear change, cold crushing strength and chemical analysis can be done on the same test specimen. Extra tests can be done on the same test specimens if agreed between the purchaser and the supplier (IS 10047 : 2023, Note under 4.3).
Clause 4.2 needs an agreement between the purchaser and the supplier (IS 10047 : 2023, Foreword).
IS 10047 : 2023 does not apply to dry vibratable masses (1.2). Confirm that the material is a ramming mass / plastic within the scope.
Clause 7.3 example says that for a lot of 10 to 50 metric tonnes, 2 bags should be collected; Table 1 gives 4 bags for over 25 tonnes up to 50 tonnes. (Discrepancy within IS 10047 : 2023.)

IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.6.2.2 Notes: 1) Whenever possible, portions of refractories left after some tests may be used to prepare test specimens or samples for other tests. 2) This applies only when other tests are called for, and not when only these tests are asked. Prepare the test specimens for each test from different refractories as per the specimen details given under each test. Test the specimens for each test one by one.

Sample quantity: IS 10047 : 2023 (4.2, Table 1) asks for 50 kg containers/bags selected by lot weight (minimum about 50 kg sample). IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.5.2 (general for mortars and monolithics) asks for about 1 kg from each of three containers/bags. IS 10047 is the product standard for ramming mass.
For deciding compliance, round off the final value (observed or calculated) as per IS 2. Keep the same number of significant places as in the specified value (IS 1528 (Part 7), Foreword; 5.2.9).

hi.title: Refractory Plastic और Ramming Mass का नमूना लेना (Lot, नमूना मात्रा, घटाना और अनुरूपता)
hi.purpose: भौतिक परीक्षणों और रासायनिक विश्लेषण के लिए refractory ramming mass / plastic के lot से प्रतिनिधि नमूना लेना और घटाना।
hi.scope: IS 10047 : 2023 refractory plastic और ramming mass के नमूना लेने और परीक्षण की विधियाँ देता है (1.1)। यह dry vibratable masses के नमूने और परीक्षण को शामिल नहीं करता (1.2)। Dry mix या dry vibratable refractory: बिना आकार का refractory जो सूखी अवस्था में vibration या ramming द्वारा लगाया जाता है (3.4)। IS 1528 (Part 7) : 2010 refractory कच्चे माल, तैयार आकार वाले refractories, mortars और monolithics (refractory castables को छोड़कर) के नमूना लेने की विधियाँ और अनुरूपता के मानदंड देता है (1)।
hi.reference: IS 10047 : 2023 (First Revision), Clauses 1, 3, 4, 5.1, 7 (7.2.1, 7.3, 7.4, 7.5); IS 1528 (Part 7) : 2010 (Second Revision, Reaffirmed 2020), Clauses 1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5 (4.5.1, 4.5.2), 4.6.2.2, 5.2.1 to 5.2.10, तथा Amendment No. 1 (December 2022), Clauses 5.2.11 और 5.2.12
hi.principle: एक ही प्रकार और grade के, एक ही निर्माता के, समान उत्पादन स्थितियों में बने सभी containers/bags एक lot बनाते हैं (अधिकतम 50 tonnes) (IS 10047, 4.1; IS 1528 Part 7, 4.5.1)। IS 10047 की Table 1 के अनुसार बोरे random चुने जाते हैं ताकि न्यूनतम लगभग 50 kg मिले। माल मिलाकर coning and quartering से परीक्षण नमूनों में घटाया जाता है। lot को specification के विरुद्ध IS 10047, 7.4 और IS 1528 (Part 7), 5.2 के अनुरूपता मानदंडों से परखा जाता है।
apparatus: बोरे खाली करने के लिए उपयुक्त सूखी सतह / सूखा फर्श (7.2.1, 7.3)
मिलाने के लिए फावड़ा या अन्य उपयुक्त औजार (7.3)
Balance — laboratory balance, 10 kg क्षमता, ± 0.1 g शुद्धता (7.1 c)
hi.sampling:
Lot (IS 10047, 4.1): किसी भी consignment में एक ही प्रकार और grade के, एक ही निर्माता द्वारा समान उत्पादन स्थितियों में बने refractory plastic/ramming mass के सभी containers/bags को एक साथ रखें। यह एक lot है। lot का अधिकतम द्रव्यमान 50 tonnes है।
Lot (IS 1528 Part 7, 4.5.1): किसी भी consignment में एक ही प्रकार और grade के, एक ही firm द्वारा समान उत्पादन स्थितियों में बने refractory mortar या monolithics के सभी containers/bags को एक साथ रखें। यह एक lot है। lot का अधिकतम वजन 50 tonnes है।
नमूना मात्रा (IS 10047, 4.2): सभी परीक्षण पूरे करने के लिए लगभग 50 kg न्यूनतम नमूना चाहिए। माल सामान्यतः 50 kg containers/bags में आता है, इसलिए containers/bags की संख्या Table 1 के अनुसार random चुनें।
नमूनों की संख्या और वजन (IS 1528 Part 7, 4.5.2): हर lot से पूरे lot में से तीन containers/bags random चुनें। हर चुने container/bag से अच्छी तरह मिलाने और coning and quartering के बाद लगभग 1 kg माल pyrometric cone equivalent, moisture content, sieve analysis और रासायनिक विश्लेषण के परीक्षणों के लिए लें। यदि lot में तीन से कम containers हों, तो हर container से 1 kg माल लें (Note to 4.5.2)।
procedure: एक consignment के containers/bags को 4.1 के अनुसार lots में बाँटें (एक ही प्रकार और grade, एक ही निर्माता, समान उत्पादन स्थितियाँ; हर lot अधिकतम 50 tonnes)।
हर lot से Table 1 में दी गई संख्या में 50 kg containers/bags random चुनें (4.2)।

यदि निर्माता के परीक्षण परिणाम purchaser को उपलब्ध न हों, या आपूर्ति में अलग-अलग kilns का माल हो, या supplier अज्ञात या नया हो, तो IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.5 की विधि अपनाई जा सकती है (IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.2 और 4.3)।

IS 1528 (Part 7), 4.5.2: पूरे lot में से तीन containers/bags random चुनें (यदि lot में तीन से कम containers हों, तो हर container लें)। हर चुने container/bag से अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ, coning and quartering करें, और pyrometric cone equivalent, moisture content, sieve analysis और रासायनिक विश्लेषण के लिए लगभग 1 kg माल लें।
Dry ramming mass (7.2.1): चुने हुए containers/bags को उपयुक्त सूखी सतह पर खाली करें। माल को अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ।
मिले हुए माल को coning and quartering से 50 kg तक घटाएँ (7.2.1)।
इस अंतिम नमूने को बार-बार coning and quartering करके पाँच बराबर परीक्षण नमूनों में बाँटें (7.2.1)।
Plastic और wet ramming mass (7.3): चुने हुए containers/bags/batches को सूखे फर्श पर खाली करें। plastic refractories के लिए बोरे Table 1 के अनुसार random लें।

Wet ramming mass के लिए चुने हुए containers/bags को उपयुक्त सूखी सतह पर खाली करें ताकि माल दूषित न हो। फावड़े या अन्य उपयुक्त औजार से मिलाएँ। ढेर के अलग-अलग स्थानों से आवश्यक मात्रा लें, जैसा purchaser और supplier के बीच तय हो (7.3)।
परीक्षण टुकड़े (test pieces) बनाने के लिए riffle (quartering – coning) sampler से माल घटाएँ। batch का आकार आवश्यक test pieces की संख्या पर निर्भर है (7.5)।

लिए गए नमूनों का उपयोग 4.3 में दिए भौतिक परीक्षणों और रासायनिक विश्लेषण के लिए करें: a) Pyrometric cone equivalent (PCE); b) Apparent porosity; c) Bulk density (BD); d) Permanent linear change (PLC); e) Cold crushing strength (CCS); f) Thermal conductivity; g) Hot modulus of rupture (HMOR)।

रासायनिक विश्लेषण का नमूना (5.1): ramming specimen का रासायनिक विश्लेषण loss free basis पर करें। 50 mm × 50 mm cylindrical test specimen (clause 7 के अनुसार बना) को gravimetric analysis के लिए 104 microns तक या instrumental analysis के लिए 45 microns तक पीसें।
सुनिश्चित करें कि चुने specimen की bulk density (BD) purchaser और supplier के बीच तय सीमाओं के भीतर हो (5.1)।
