जहाँ A = नमूने के लिए लगा standard potassium iodate solution, ml में; B = blank के लिए लगा आयतन, ml में; C = standard potassium iodate solution का tin equivalent, g/ml में; D = लिए गए नमूने का द्रव्यमान, g में।
hi.reporting: परिणाम को IS 2 : 1960 के अनुसार round off करें (IS 504, Foreword)। Significant places की संख्या IS 1253 में दिए specified value के समान रखें (IS 1253, Foreword)। Tin को IS 1253, Table 1 की Grade 2 सीमा के सामने report करें।

keywords: aluminium al purity impurities copper zinc magnesium silicon iron tin manganese shot notch bar wire ingot manganese in aluminium (bismuthate)

en.title: Determination of Manganese in Aluminium — Bismuthate Method (IS 504 Part 5 : 2002)
en.purpose: To determine manganese in aluminium (shot / notch bar / other shapes) used for iron and steel making, when it is present or required.
en.scope: Manganese 0.1 to 1.5 percent in aluminium for iron and steel manufacture. Manganese is not a specified constituent of IS 1253 : 1992, Table 1.
en.reference: IS 504 (Part 5) : 2002 (Second Revision, Reaffirmed 2023), cl. 3, 4 and 5; IS 1253 : 1992 (Third Revision, Reaffirmed 2022), cl. 6 and 8.
en.range: Manganese 0.1 to 1.5 percent (Part 5, scope).
en.principle: Manganese is oxidized to permanganic acid by sodium bismuthate in nitric acid medium. The permanganate formed is titrated with standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution (cl. 5.1).
apparatus: Fritted glass crucible and dark-coloured stoppered bottle (5.2.8)

reagents.name: Quality of reagents (IS 504, cl. 4)
reagents.prep: Use analytical grade reagents and reagent grade water (see IS 1070), unless stated otherwise.

reagents.name: Sodium bismuthate (5.2.2)
reagents.prep: Solid.

reagents.name: Sulphurous acid (5.2.3)
reagents.prep: Make about 5 percent solution of sulphur dioxide in water.

reagents.name: Phosphoric acid (5.2.5)
reagents.prep: 85 percent (m/v).

reagents.name: Standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution, 0.03 N (5.2.6)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 6 g of ferrous ammonium sulphate [Fe(NH<sub>4</sub>)<sub>2</sub>(SO<sub>4</sub>)<sub>2</sub>.6H<sub>2</sub>O] in cold dilute sulphuric acid (5:95). Make up to 500 ml with this acid. Mix well and keep in an amber-coloured glass-stoppered bottle.

reagents.name: Standard sodium oxalate solution (5.2.7)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 2.01 g of sodium oxalate in water and make up to 1 litre in a graduated flask.

reagents.name: Standard potassium permanganate solution, 0.030 N (5.2.8)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 0.958 g of potassium permanganate in water and dilute to 1 000 ml. Keep the solution in a dark place for two weeks. Filter without washing through a fritted glass crucible and store in a dark-coloured stoppered bottle. Standardize against standard sodium oxalate solution.

en.sampling: Draw and prepare the sample as per IS 1817 (IS 504, cl. 3; IS 1253, cl. 8.2) — see DM/QA/SOP/04. Take one sample for each cast or for every 1 000 kg or part of it (IS 1253, cl. 8.1). For shot, melt the sample and chill cast it as a bar about 6 mm thick (IS 1253, cl. 8.3). Use drillings/millings of the prepared sample. Sample mass: as per Table 4.
procedure: (5.3.1) Choose the sample mass and volume of sodium hydroxide solution from Table 4, as per the manganese content. Weigh the sample accurately and transfer it with the sodium hydroxide solution to a 500 ml beaker.
Treat the sample with 25 ml of sodium hydroxide solution (50 ml for 2 g of sample). Bring to boiling on a hot plate until all visible action stops.
For silicon content greater than 4 percent, concentrate the solution at this stage to about half volume.
Cool slightly. Add 60 ml of the acid mixture (100 ml for a 2 g sample). Wash down the sides of the beaker. Boil gently until solution is complete and nitrous fumes are expelled.
(5.3.2) Neutralize the solution with nitric acid and add 40 ml in excess. Boil the solution and add 0.5 g of sodium bismuthate. Boil for 2 to 3 min.
Dissolve the precipitated oxides of manganese with sulphurous acid, added drop by drop until the solution is clear. Boil to expel oxides of sulphur and nitrogen.
Dilute to about 100 ml with water. Cool the solution to 10 to 15 °C.
(5.3.3) Add about 0.5 g of sodium bismuthate (or 26 times the manganese content of the sample, but not less than 0.5 g). Agitate for 2 or 3 min.
Filter at once through an asbestos Gooch crucible. Wash with cold dilute nitric acid (3:97) until the washings are colourless. Reject the insoluble residue.
Keep the filtrate at 10 to 15 °C. Add 2 ml of syrupy phosphoric acid to the measured excess of standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution.
Titrate the excess ferrous iron at once with standard permanganate solution to a faint pink colour.

(5.3.4) Carry out a blank determination with the same procedure, using the same amount of standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution and other reagents as used in the titration, but without the sample.
en.end_point: Faint pink colour (permanganate).

tables.title: Table 4 Manganese — mass of sample and sodium hydroxide solution (IS 504 Part 5, 5.3.1)
rows: Mass in g of the Sample to be Taken
Volume in ml of Sodium Hydroxide Solution Required

calculation: Manganese (5.4): Manganese, percent = (A − B) × C × 1.1 / D

where A = volume in ml of standard permanganate solution used for the blank; B = volume in ml of standard permanganate solution used for the excess of ferrous ammonium sulphate solution; C = normality of the standard permanganate solution; D = mass in g of sample taken.
en.reporting: Round off the result as per IS 2 : 1960 (IS 504, Foreword). Keep the same number of significant places as the specified value in IS 1253 (IS 1253, Foreword). Report manganese, percent.
notes: Manganese is not a specified constituent of IS 1253, Table 1. Determine it only if present or required.

hi.title: Aluminium में Manganese का निर्धारण — Bismuthate विधि (IS 504 Part 5 : 2002)
hi.purpose: Iron और steel निर्माण में उपयोग होने वाले aluminium (shot / notch bar / अन्य आकार) में manganese ज्ञात करना, जब यह उपस्थित हो या आवश्यक हो।
hi.scope: Iron और steel निर्माण हेतु aluminium में 0.1 से 1.5 प्रतिशत manganese। Manganese, IS 1253 : 1992, Table 1 का specified घटक नहीं है।
hi.reference: IS 504 (Part 5) : 2002 (Second Revision, Reaffirmed 2023), cl. 3, 4 और 5; IS 1253 : 1992 (Third Revision, Reaffirmed 2022), cl. 6 और 8।
hi.range: 0.1 से 1.5 प्रतिशत manganese (Part 5, scope)।
hi.principle: Nitric acid माध्यम में sodium bismuthate द्वारा manganese को permanganic acid में oxidize किया जाता है। बने permanganate को standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution से titrate किया जाता है (cl. 5.1)।
apparatus: Fritted glass crucible और गहरे रंग की stoppered bottle (5.2.8)

reagents.name: Reagents की गुणवत्ता (Quality of reagents) (IS 504, cl. 4)
reagents.prep: जब तक अलग से न कहा गया हो, analytical grade reagents और reagent grade water (IS 1070 देखें) का उपयोग करें।

reagents.name: Sodium bismuthate (5.2.2)
reagents.prep: ठोस (Solid)।

reagents.name: Sulphurous acid (5.2.3)
reagents.prep: पानी में sulphur dioxide का लगभग 5 प्रतिशत solution बनाएँ।

reagents.name: Phosphoric acid (5.2.5)
reagents.prep: 85 प्रतिशत (m/v)।

reagents.name: Standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution, 0.03 N (5.2.6)
reagents.prep: 6 g ferrous ammonium sulphate [Fe(NH<sub>4</sub>)<sub>2</sub>(SO<sub>4</sub>)<sub>2</sub>.6H<sub>2</sub>O] को ठंडे dilute sulphuric acid (5:95) में घोलें। इसी acid से 500 ml बनाएँ। अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ और amber रंग की glass-stoppered bottle में रखें।

reagents.name: Standard sodium oxalate solution (5.2.7)
reagents.prep: 2.01 g sodium oxalate को पानी में घोलें और graduated flask में 1 litre बनाएँ।

reagents.name: Standard potassium permanganate solution, 0.030 N (5.2.8)
reagents.prep: 0.958 g potassium permanganate को पानी में घोलकर 1 000 ml तक पतला करें। Solution को दो सप्ताह अंधेरे स्थान पर रखें। Fritted glass crucible से बिना धोए filter करें और गहरे रंग की stoppered bottle में रखें। Standard sodium oxalate solution से मानकीकरण करें।

hi.sampling: नमूना IS 1817 के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें (IS 504, cl. 3; IS 1253, cl. 8.2) — DM/QA/SOP/04 देखें। प्रत्येक cast या प्रत्येक 1 000 kg या उसके भाग से एक नमूना लें (IS 1253, cl. 8.1)। Shot होने पर नमूने को पिघलाकर लगभग 6 mm मोटी bar के रूप में chill cast करें (IS 1253, cl. 8.3)। तैयार नमूने की drillings/millings का उपयोग करें। नमूने का द्रव्यमान: Table 4 के अनुसार।
procedure: (5.3.1) Manganese की मात्रा के अनुसार नमूने का द्रव्यमान और sodium hydroxide solution का आयतन Table 4 से चुनें। नमूना सही-सही तौलें और sodium hydroxide solution के साथ 500 ml beaker में डालें।
नमूने को 25 ml sodium hydroxide solution से उपचारित करें (2 g नमूने के लिए 50 ml)। Hot plate पर उबाल पर लाएँ जब तक सारी दिखाई देने वाली क्रिया बंद न हो जाए।
4 प्रतिशत से अधिक silicon होने पर इसी चरण पर solution को लगभग आधे आयतन तक गाढ़ा करें।
थोड़ा ठंडा करें। 60 ml acid mixture डालें (2 g नमूने के लिए 100 ml)। Beaker की दीवारें धोकर नीचे करें। पूरा घुलने और nitrous fumes निकलने तक धीरे उबालें।
(5.3.2) Solution को nitric acid से neutralize करें और 40 ml अधिक डालें। Solution उबालें और 0.5 g sodium bismuthate डालें। 2 से 3 min उबालें।
अवक्षेपित manganese oxides को sulphurous acid से घोलें; solution साफ़ होने तक बूँद-बूँद डालें। Sulphur और nitrogen के oxides निकालने के लिए उबालें।
पानी से लगभग 100 ml तक पतला करें। Solution को 10 से 15 °C तक ठंडा करें।
(5.3.3) लगभग 0.5 g sodium bismuthate डालें (या नमूने की manganese मात्रा का 26 गुना, पर 0.5 g से कम नहीं)। 2 या 3 min हिलाएँ।
तुरंत asbestos Gooch crucible से filter करें। धोवन रंगहीन होने तक ठंडे dilute nitric acid (3:97) से धोएँ। अघुलनशील residue फेंक दें।
Filtrate का तापमान 10 से 15 °C रखें। मापे गए अधिक (measured excess) standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution में 2 ml syrupy phosphoric acid डालें।
अतिरिक्त ferrous iron को तुरंत standard permanganate solution से हल्के गुलाबी रंग तक titrate करें।
(5.3.4) उसी विधि से, titration में प्रयुक्त standard ferrous ammonium sulphate solution और अन्य reagents की समान मात्रा के साथ, बिना नमूने के blank determination करें।
hi.end_point: हल्का गुलाबी रंग (permanganate)।

tables.title: Table 4 Manganese — नमूने का द्रव्यमान और sodium hydroxide solution (IS 504 Part 5, 5.3.1)
rows: लिया जाने वाला नमूना, g (Mass of Sample)
आवश्यक sodium hydroxide solution, ml (Volume Required)

calculation: Manganese (5.4): Manganese, प्रतिशत = (A − B) × C × 1.1 / D

जहाँ A = blank के titration में लगा standard permanganate solution, ml में; B = अतिरिक्त ferrous ammonium sulphate solution के titration में लगा standard permanganate solution, ml में; C = standard permanganate solution की normality; D = लिए गए नमूने का द्रव्यमान, g में।
hi.reporting: परिणाम को IS 2 : 1960 के अनुसार round off करें (IS 504, Foreword)। Significant places की संख्या IS 1253 में दिए specified value के समान रखें (IS 1253, Foreword)। Manganese को प्रतिशत में report करें।
notes: Manganese, IS 1253, Table 1 का specified घटक नहीं है। इसे केवल उपस्थित होने या आवश्यक होने पर ज्ञात करें।

keywords: zinc zn fes dust bag filter fume extraction ferrocyanide edta zinc in fes dust (ferrocyanide)

en.title: Determination of Zinc in FES (Fume Extraction System) Dust by Potassium Ferrocyanide Method — adapted from IS 9252 : 1979
en.purpose: To find zinc (as Zn) in FES / bag-filter dust by the potassium ferrocyanide volumetric method of IS 9252 : 1979.
en.scope: IS 9252 : 1979 gives methods for volumetric determination of zinc by (a) potassium ferrocyanide and (b) ethylenediamine tetraacetate (EDTA) (cl. 1.1). This WI covers method (a) only. The IS aims at a uniform method for zinc in various Indian Standards (0.3); it does not name FES dust. Its use for FES (Fume Extraction System) dust is a laboratory adaptation. Validate the method before use (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1).
en.principle: Decompose the sample with hydrochloric acid and nitric acid. Pass hydrogen sulphide gas to precipitate cadmium and copper. Add ammonium chloride, ammonium hydroxide and bromine water to the filtrate to remove iron and manganese. Add hydrochloric acid and titrate with potassium ferrocyanide standard solution, using uranyl salt indicator (3.1).
apparatus: Watch glass (3.3.1, 3.3.5); filter paper and funnel (3.3.2, 3.3.3)
Porcelain plate (spot plate) and glass rod for external indicator (3.3.8)
Brown bottle for storing potassium ferrocyanide standard solution (3.2.16.1)

reagents.name: Quality of reagents (2.1)
reagents.prep: Use pure chemicals and distilled water (see IS : 1070-1977), unless stated otherwise. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that do not contain impurities which affect the results (Note).

reagents.name: Ammonium chloride wash solution (3.2.12)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 20 g of ammonium chloride in water. Add 10 ml of ammonium hydroxide. Dilute to 1 litre.

reagents.name: Hydrogen sulphide water (3.2.14)
reagents.prep: Saturated.

reagents.name: Uranyl salt indicator (3.2.15)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 10 g of uranyl acetate or uranyl nitrate in water. Dilute to 100 ml.

reagents.name: Potassium ferrocyanide standard solution (3.2.16)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 21.6 g of potassium ferrocyanide in water. Dilute with water to 1 litre. Standardize as in 3.2.16.1 (see Standardisation table). Store in a brown bottle in a dark place. Restandardize before use.

en.sampling: Sample mass (3.3.1): Weigh accurately 0.3 to 1 g of the sample.
procedure: Decomposition (cl. 3.3.1): Weigh accurately 0.3 to 1 g of the sample into a 300-ml beaker. Cover with a watch glass and moisten with a little water.
Add 20 to 30 ml of hydrochloric acid. Heat gently to drive off sulphur (from sulphide) as hydrogen sulphide gas.
Add 10 ml of nitric acid. Continue heating to decompose the sample completely. Evaporate to near dryness.
Cool. Add 10 ml of hydrochloric acid (1 : 1) to dissolve soluble salts. Dilute with water to a 3 percent by volume hydrochloric acid solution.
Removal of cadmium and copper (cl. 3.3.2): Heat the solution to 80 to 90 °C. At once pass hydrogen sulphide gas for 20 to 30 minutes.

Let it stand a while. Filter, and wash the filter paper with hydrochloric acid (1 : 50) saturated with hydrogen sulphide gas. Collect the filtrate and washings in a 500-ml beaker. Keep it as the main solution.
(cl. 3.3.3) Place the original beaker under the funnel. Add 9 ml of hydrochloric acid (1 : 2) drop by drop on the filter paper to dissolve the precipitate. Wash with about 100 ml of warm water.

(cl. 3.3.4) Heat the solution and pass hydrogen sulphide gas to precipitate sulphides, in the same way as 3.3.2 (heat to 80 to 90 °C, pass H2S for 20 to 30 minutes, stand a while, filter, wash with HCl (1 : 50) saturated with H2S). Filter, wash, and add the filtrate and washings to the main solution kept in 3.3.2.
Removal of iron and manganese (cl. 3.3.5): Heat the solution and evaporate to about 50 ml. Add a little bromine water or hydrogen peroxide water. Heat to oxidize iron, etc.
Add 5 g of ammonium chloride. While stirring, add 15 ml of ammonium hydroxide to precipitate iron, etc.
Then add 10 to 20 ml of bromine water or 0.5 g of ammonium persulphate. Cover with a watch glass and boil for a few minutes.
(cl. 3.3.6) Let it stand a while. Filter into a 500-ml conical flask. Wash the filter paper several times with ammonium chloride wash solution. Keep the filtrate and washings as the main solution.
Wash the precipitate with water into the original beaker. Add 10 ml of hydrochloric acid (1 : 1) and heat to dissolve the precipitate.
(cl. 3.3.7) Add 3 g of ammonium chloride. Repeat 3.3.5 (ammonium hydroxide, and bromine water or ammonium persulphate) to precipitate iron, etc.
Filter the precipitate through the original filter paper. Wash with ammonium chloride wash solution. Add the filtrate and washings to the main solution.
Boil the solution for a few minutes to destroy excess bromine or ammonium persulphate. Adjust the volume to about 200 ml.
Titration (cl. 3.3.8): Add hydrochloric acid drop by drop to neutralize the solution against litmus paper. Add 5 ml more of the acid, then 50 ml of hydrogen sulphide water (saturated).
Keep the solution at 75 to 80 °C. Titrate with potassium ferrocyanide solution, using uranyl salt as external indicator.
Add the potassium ferrocyanide solution in small portions at first. Shake the flask each time. The precipitate slowly becomes fine and turns milky near the end point.
Near the end point add 1 or 2 drops of standard solution at a time and shake the flask after each addition.
Take 1 drop of the solution with a glass rod onto a porcelain plate. Mix it with the external indicator on the plate.
Continue the titration until the mixed spot changes colour from yellowish green to pale brown.
Titrate 3 times to get the exact volume of potassium ferrocyanide solution (V<sub>1</sub>).
Run a blank with all reagents under the same conditions (V<sub>2</sub>). Calculate the zinc content (3.4).
en.end_point: External indicator (uranyl salt) on a porcelain plate — the mixed spot changes colour from yellowish green to pale brown. Titrate at 75 to 80 °C (3.3.8).

tables.title: Standardisation of potassium ferrocyanide standard solution
rows: Weigh accurately 0.25 g of zinc into a 500-ml conical flask. Add 10 ml of hydrochloric acid to dissolve it completely. Add 100 ml of water and 14 g of ammonium chloride. Neutralize with ammonium hydroxide using litmus paper, and add 5 ml of hydrochloric acid. Add 50 ml of hydrogen sulphide water (saturated) and dilute with water to about 250 ml. Titrate zinc as per 3.3.5 (as printed in IS).

calculation: Standardisation (3.2.16.1): m = M / (V1 − V2)

where m = mass in g of zinc equal to 1 ml of potassium ferrocyanide solution; M = mass in g of zinc taken; V<sub>1</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used in titration; V<sub>2</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used for the blank.
Sample (3.4): Zinc (as Zn), percent by mass = [m × (V1 − V2) / M] × 100

where m = mass in g of zinc equal to 1 ml of potassium ferrocyanide solution; V<sub>1</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used in titration for sample; V<sub>2</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used for the blank; M = mass in g of the sample taken (in the test solution).
en.reporting: If the final value (observed or calculated) is to be rounded off, round it as per IS : 2-1960 (0.5).
notes: Foreword (0.2): the accuracy of the volumetric method compares well with the gravimetric method. The volumetric method is faster when many samples are to be analysed. Assistance was taken from JIS M 8124-1965 'Methods for determination of zinc in ores' (0.4).
Validate the method for FES dust before use (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1).
Store potassium ferrocyanide standard solution in a brown bottle in a dark place. Restandardize before use (3.2.16.1).
Titrate 3 times to get the exact volume. Run the blank with all reagents under the same conditions (3.3.8).
Reagents listed in IS but not used in the written procedure: sulphuric acid (1 : 2), ammonium carbonate, HCl (1 : 5) (as printed in IS).

hi.title: FES (Fume Extraction System) Dust में Zinc का निर्धारण — Potassium Ferrocyanide विधि, IS 9252 : 1979 से अनुकूलित
hi.purpose: IS 9252 : 1979 की potassium ferrocyanide volumetric विधि से FES / bag-filter dust में zinc (Zn के रूप में) ज्ञात करना।
hi.scope: IS 9252 : 1979 में zinc के volumetric निर्धारण की विधियाँ (a) potassium ferrocyanide और (b) ethylenediamine tetraacetate (EDTA) द्वारा दी गई हैं (cl. 1.1)। यह WI केवल विधि (a) को कवर करता है। IS का उद्देश्य विभिन्न Indian Standards में zinc की एक समान विधि देना है (0.3); इसमें FES dust का नाम नहीं है। FES (Fume Extraction System) dust पर इसका प्रयोग laboratory adaptation है। प्रयोग से पहले विधि validate करें (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1)।
hi.principle: नमूने को hydrochloric acid और nitric acid से decompose करें। Cadmium और copper को precipitate करने के लिए hydrogen sulphide gas प्रवाहित करें। Iron और manganese हटाने के लिए filtrate में ammonium chloride, ammonium hydroxide और bromine water डालें। Hydrochloric acid डालकर uranyl salt indicator के साथ potassium ferrocyanide standard solution से titrate करें (3.1)।
apparatus: Watch glass (3.3.1, 3.3.5); filter paper और funnel (3.3.2, 3.3.3)
External indicator के लिए porcelain plate (spot plate) और glass rod (3.3.8)
Potassium ferrocyanide standard solution रखने के लिए brown bottle (3.2.16.1)

reagents.name: रसायनों की गुणवत्ता (2.1)
reagents.prep: जब तक अन्यथा न कहा गया हो, pure chemicals और distilled water (देखें IS : 1070-1977) प्रयोग करें। 'Pure chemicals' का अर्थ है ऐसे रसायन जिनमें परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाली अशुद्धियाँ न हों (Note)।

reagents.name: Ammonium chloride wash solution (3.2.12)
reagents.prep: 20 g ammonium chloride पानी में घोलें। 10 ml ammonium hydroxide डालें। 1 litre तक dilute करें।

reagents.name: Hydrogen sulphide water (3.2.14)
reagents.prep: Saturated।

reagents.name: Uranyl salt indicator (3.2.15)
reagents.prep: 10 g uranyl acetate या uranyl nitrate पानी में घोलें। 100 ml तक dilute करें।

reagents.name: Potassium ferrocyanide standard solution (3.2.16)
reagents.prep: 21.6 g potassium ferrocyanide पानी में घोलें। पानी से 1 litre तक dilute करें। 3.2.16.1 के अनुसार standardize करें (Standardisation तालिका देखें)। Brown bottle में अँधेरी जगह रखें। प्रयोग से पहले फिर से standardize करें।

procedure: Decomposition (cl. 3.3.1): 0.3 से 1 g नमूना सही-सही तौलकर 300-ml beaker में लें। Watch glass से ढकें और थोड़े पानी से गीला करें।
20 से 30 ml hydrochloric acid डालें। Sulphide के sulphur को hydrogen sulphide gas के रूप में निकालने के लिए धीरे गरम करें।
10 ml nitric acid डालें। नमूना पूरी तरह decompose होने तक गरम करते रहें। लगभग सूखने तक evaporate करें।
ठंडा करें। Soluble salts घोलने के लिए 10 ml hydrochloric acid (1 : 1) डालें। पानी से 3 percent by volume hydrochloric acid solution तक dilute करें।
Cadmium और copper हटाना (cl. 3.3.2): Solution को 80 से 90 °C तक गरम करें। तुरंत 20 से 30 minutes तक hydrogen sulphide gas प्रवाहित करें।

कुछ देर रखें। Filter करें, और filter paper को hydrogen sulphide gas से saturated hydrochloric acid (1 : 50) से धोएँ। Filtrate और washings 500-ml beaker में इकट्ठा करें। इसे main solution के रूप में रखें।
(cl. 3.3.3) मूल beaker को funnel के नीचे रखें। Precipitate घोलने के लिए filter paper पर 9 ml hydrochloric acid (1 : 2) बूँद-बूँद डालें। लगभग 100 ml गुनगुने पानी से धोएँ।

(cl. 3.3.4) Solution गरम करें और sulphides precipitate करने के लिए hydrogen sulphide gas, 3.3.2 की तरह, प्रवाहित करें (80 से 90 °C तक गरम करें, 20 से 30 minutes H2S प्रवाहित करें, कुछ देर रखें, filter करें, H2S से saturated HCl (1 : 50) से धोएँ)। Filter करें, धोएँ, और filtrate व washings को 3.3.2 में रखे main solution में मिलाएँ।
Iron और manganese हटाना (cl. 3.3.5): Solution को गरम करके लगभग 50 ml तक evaporate करें। थोड़ा bromine water या hydrogen peroxide water डालें। Iron आदि को oxidize करने के लिए गरम करें।
5 g ammonium chloride डालें। Iron आदि को precipitate करने के लिए हिलाते हुए 15 ml ammonium hydroxide डालें।
फिर 10 से 20 ml bromine water या 0.5 g ammonium persulphate डालें। Watch glass से ढककर कुछ minutes उबालें।
(cl. 3.3.6) कुछ देर रखें। 500-ml conical flask में filter करें। Filter paper को ammonium chloride wash solution से कई बार धोएँ। Filtrate और washings को main solution के रूप में रखें।
Precipitate को पानी से धोकर मूल beaker में डालें। 10 ml hydrochloric acid (1 : 1) डालें और precipitate घोलने के लिए गरम करें।
(cl. 3.3.7) 3 g ammonium chloride डालें। Iron आदि को precipitate करने के लिए 3.3.5 (ammonium hydroxide, और bromine water या ammonium persulphate) दोहराएँ।
Precipitate को मूल filter paper से filter करें। Ammonium chloride wash solution से धोएँ। Filtrate और washings को main solution में मिलाएँ।
अतिरिक्त bromine या ammonium persulphate नष्ट करने के लिए solution को कुछ minutes उबालें। Volume लगभग 200 ml करें।
Titration (cl. 3.3.8): Litmus paper से जाँचते हुए solution को neutralize करने के लिए hydrochloric acid बूँद-बूँद डालें। 5 ml acid और डालें, फिर 50 ml hydrogen sulphide water (saturated) डालें।
Solution को 75 से 80 °C पर रखें। Uranyl salt को external indicator के रूप में प्रयोग करते हुए potassium ferrocyanide solution से titrate करें।
शुरू में potassium ferrocyanide solution थोड़ा-थोड़ा डालें। हर बार flask हिलाएँ। Precipitate धीरे-धीरे बारीक होता है और end point के पास दूधिया हो जाता है।
End point के पास एक बार में 1 या 2 बूँद standard solution डालें और हर बार flask हिलाएँ।
Glass rod से solution की 1 बूँद porcelain plate पर लें। उसे plate पर रखे external indicator से मिलाएँ।
मिली हुई बूँद का रंग yellowish green से pale brown होने तक titration जारी रखें।
Potassium ferrocyanide solution का सही volume पाने के लिए 3 बार titrate करें (V<sub>1</sub>)।
सभी reagents के साथ समान शर्तों पर blank चलाएँ (V<sub>2</sub>)। Zinc की मात्रा की गणना करें (3.4)।
hi.end_point: Porcelain plate पर external indicator (uranyl salt) — मिली हुई बूँद का रंग yellowish green से pale brown हो जाता है। 75 से 80 °C पर titrate करें (3.3.8)।

tables.title: Potassium ferrocyanide standard solution का standardisation

en.title: Determination of Zinc in FES (Fume Extraction System) Dust by EDTA Method (Ion Exchange) — adapted from IS 9252 : 1979
en.purpose: To find zinc (as Zn) in FES / bag-filter dust by the EDTA volumetric method of IS 9252 : 1979.
en.scope: IS 9252 : 1979 gives methods for volumetric determination of zinc by (a) potassium ferrocyanide and (b) ethylenediamine tetraacetate (EDTA) (cl. 1.1). This WI covers method (b) only. The IS aims at a uniform method for zinc in various Indian Standards (0.3); it does not name FES dust. Its use for FES (Fume Extraction System) dust is a laboratory adaptation. Validate the method before use (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1).
en.principle: Decompose the sample with hydrochloric acid and nitric acid. Hold the zinc on a strongly basic anion exchange resin. Wash the resin column with dilute hydrochloric acid. Then elute the zinc with dilute ammonium hydroxide containing ammonium chloride. Adjust the pH of the eluate to about 5.5 and titrate with EDTA standard solution, using xylenol orange indicator (4.1).
apparatus: Watch glass (4.4.1); filter paper and funnel

Ion-exchange resin column as in Fig. 1 of IS 9252 (4.2.1): dropping funnel (100 ml), 30 mm ID, overall 230 mm, with stopcock; column tube 10 mm ID, overall 300 mm, resin column length 200 mm, glass filter (G1) and stopcock (all dimensions in mm)
Strongly basic anion exchange resin, grain size 215 to 150 micron IS sieve (see IS : 460-1962) (4.2.1)

reagents.name: Quality of reagents (2.1)
reagents.prep: Use pure chemicals and distilled water (see IS : 1070-1977), unless stated otherwise. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that do not contain impurities which affect the results (Note).

reagents.name: Ascorbic acid - hydrochloric acid solution (4.3.6)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 0.25 g of ascorbic acid in hydrochloric acid (1 : 5). Dilute to 100 ml.

reagents.name: Ammonium hydroxide (7 : 100) (4.2.1)
reagents.prep: For conditioning the resin column.

reagents.name: Ammoniacal eluent (4.3.7)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 20 g of ammonium chloride in 1 litre of ammonium hydroxide (7 : 100).

reagents.name: Buffer solution (4.3.8)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 250 g of ammonium acetate in water. Add 25 ml of glacial acetic acid and dilute with water to 1 litre. Adjust the pH to about 5.5 with a pH meter.

reagents.name: Ammonium fluoride solution (4.3.9)
reagents.prep: 5 percent (m/v).

reagents.name: Sodium thiosulphate solution (4.3.10)
reagents.prep: 10 percent (m/v).

reagents.name: Xylenol orange indicator solution (4.3.11)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 9.1 g of xylenol orange in 100 ml of water or 100 ml of 50 percent ethyl alcohol (v/v) (mass as printed in IS).

reagents.name: Eriochrome black T indicator solution (4.3.13)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 0.5 g of eriochrome black T in 100 ml of ethyl alcohol. Add 4 g of hydroxylamine hydrochloride.

reagents.name: Zinc standard solution — 0.05 M (4.3.14)
reagents.prep: Weigh accurately 3.269 g of zinc into a 500-ml conical flask. Add 20 ml of hydrochloric acid to dissolve it. Heat the solution and dilute with water to exactly 1 litre. Standardize with EDTA standard solution (0.05 M) as in 4.3.14.1 (see Standardisation table).

reagents.name: EDTA standard solution — 0.5 M (as printed in IS) (4.3.15)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 18.610 g of disodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate dihydrate in water. Dilute to 1 litre. 1 ml of this solution is equal to about 3.269 mg of zinc. Standardize as in 4.3.15.1 (see Standardisation table). For samples with a small amount of zinc, prepare EDTA solution (0.01 M) (4.3.15.2).

en.sampling: Sample mass (4.4.1): Weigh accurately 0.3 to 1 g of the sample.
procedure: Prepare the ion-exchange column (cl. 4.2.1): Fill about 20 g of the resin with water into the tube.
Pour 100 ml of ammonium hydroxide (7 : 100) through it at 5 ml per minute. Then pour about 50 ml of water at the same rate.
Wash the column with 100 ml of hydrochloric acid (1 : 5) and then with 50 ml of water. Repeat this procedure. When the resin is used again, one washing cycle is enough.
Decomposition (cl. 4.4.1): Weigh accurately 0.3 to 1 g of the sample into a 250-ml beaker. Cover with a watch glass and moisten with a little water.
Add 20 to 30 ml of hydrochloric acid. Heat gently to drive off sulphur (from sulphide) as hydrogen sulphide gas.
Add 10 ml of nitric acid. Continue heating to decompose the sample completely.
Add 10 ml of sulphuric acid (1 : 1). Heat until white fumes come off.
Cool. Add 50 ml of water and heat to dissolve soluble salts. Cool to room temperature.
Filter the precipitate. Wash several times with cold sulphuric acid (1 : 10). Collect the filtrate and washings in a 250-ml beaker.
Pour into the dropping funnel of the apparatus. Add 16 ml of hydrochloric acid and water to make 100 ml. Mix well.
Ion exchange (cl. 4.4.2): Pour the solution onto the column at about 6 ml per minute. Let the zinc be adsorbed on the column.

After pouring, wash the column with 100 ml of hydrochloric acid, then 100 ml of ascorbic acid-hydrochloric acid solution, and finally 100 ml of hydrochloric acid. Add each solution at about 7 ml per minute.
Elution (cl. 4.4.3): Add 180 ml of ammoniacal eluent at about 6 ml per minute to elute the zinc. Collect the effluent in a 500-ml beaker.
Titration (cl. 4.4.3): Neutralize the solution with acetic acid. Add 20 ml of buffer solution to adjust the pH to 5.0 to 5.5.
Add 2.5 ml of ammonium fluoride solution 5 percent (m/v), 5 ml of sodium thiosulphate solution [10 percent (m/v)] and a few drops of xylenol orange indicator solution.
Titrate with EDTA solution until the colour changes from pink to yellow (V<sub>1</sub>).
Calculate the zinc content as in 4.5.1. V<sub>2</sub> = volume in ml of EDTA solution used for the blank.
en.end_point:
Xylenol orange at pH 5.0 to 5.5 — colour changes from pink to yellow (4.4.3).
Zinc standard check (4.3.14.1): Eriochrome black T — colour changes from blue to violet.

tables.title: Standardisation of standard solutions
rows: To 10 ml of EDTA standard solution, add 180 ml of ammoniacal eluent and a few drops of Eriochrome black T indicator solution. Titrate with the zinc solution until the colour changes from blue to violet.

Weigh accurately 0.15 g of zinc into a 500-ml conical flask. Add 10 ml of hydrochloric acid to dissolve it. Add 180 ml of ammoniacal eluent, neutralize with acetic acid (1 : 1) and proceed as in 4.4.3.

calculation: Standardisation (4.3.15.1): m = M / (V1 − V2)

where m = mass in g of zinc equal to 1 ml of EDTA solution; M = mass in g of zinc taken; V<sub>1</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used in titration; V<sub>2</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used for the blank.
Sample (4.5.1): Zinc (as Zn), percent by mass = [m × (V1 − V2) / M] × 100

where m = mass in g of zinc equal to 1 ml of EDTA solution; V<sub>1</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used in titration for sample; V<sub>2</sub> = volume in ml of the solution used for the blank; M = mass in g of the sample taken (in the test solution).
en.reporting: If the final value (observed or calculated) is to be rounded off, round it as per IS : 2-1960 (0.5).
notes: Foreword (0.2): the accuracy of the volumetric method compares well with the gravimetric method. The volumetric method is faster when many samples are to be analysed. Assistance was taken from JIS M 8124-1965 'Methods for determination of zinc in ores' (0.4).
Validate the method for FES dust before use (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1).
When the resin is used again, only one washing cycle is needed (4.2.1).
For samples with a small amount of zinc, prepare EDTA solution (0.01 M) (4.3.15.2).
Reagents listed in IS but not used in the written procedure: nitric acid (1 : 1), sodium diethyl dithiocarbamate (as printed in IS).

hi.title: FES (Fume Extraction System) Dust में Zinc का निर्धारण — EDTA विधि (Ion Exchange), IS 9252 : 1979 से अनुकूलित

hi.scope: IS 9252 : 1979 में zinc के volumetric निर्धारण की विधियाँ (a) potassium ferrocyanide और (b) ethylenediamine tetraacetate (EDTA) द्वारा दी गई हैं (cl. 1.1)। यह WI केवल विधि (b) को कवर करता है। IS का उद्देश्य विभिन्न Indian Standards में zinc की एक समान विधि देना है (0.3); इसमें FES dust का नाम नहीं है। FES (Fume Extraction System) dust पर इसका प्रयोग laboratory adaptation है। प्रयोग से पहले विधि validate करें (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1)।

en.short_title: ZnO in FES Dust (NH3 Sep. - EDTA)
en.title: Determination of Zinc Oxide (ZnO) in FES Dust — Ammonia Separation and EDTA Titration (Xylenol Orange)
en.purpose: To find zinc oxide (ZnO) in FES (Fume Extraction System) dust by EDTA titration, after removing iron and other interfering metals with ammonia.
en.scope: FES / filter dust from the Steel Melting Shop. This is the laboratory's routine method.
en.reference: Laboratory method (Procedure of ZnO in Filter Dust); ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1 (validation of laboratory-developed methods).
en.principle: The dust is dissolved in hydrochloric and nitric acids. Ammonium sulphate and potassium fluoride are added, and then excess ammonia: iron, aluminium and other metals come down as hydroxides, calcium and magnesium as fluorides and lead as sulphate, while zinc stays in solution as the zinc–ammonia complex. The solution is filtered and made up to volume. In an aliquot, the pH is adjusted with methyl orange, hydrochloric acid and ammonia, and then buffered with sodium acetate. Potassium fluoride masks aluminium, sodium thiosulphate masks copper and ascorbic acid reduces any iron(III) left. Zinc is titrated with EDTA using xylenol orange indicator; the colour changes from pink/red to yellow.
apparatus: Pipettes, 10 ml, 15 ml and 50 ml (and 5 ml for nitric acid)
Dropping bottles (methyl orange, hydrochloric acid, ammonia solution, xylenol orange)

reagents.name: Ammonium sulphate solution, 30 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 30 g ammonium sulphate in water and make up to 100 ml.

reagents.name: Potassium fluoride solution, 10 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 10 g potassium fluoride in water and make up to 100 ml. Store in a plastic bottle.

reagents.name: Methyl orange indicator
reagents.prep: In a dropping bottle.

reagents.name: Hydrochloric acid (for pH adjustment)
reagents.prep: In a dropping bottle.

reagents.name: Sodium thiosulphate solution, 10 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 10 g sodium thiosulphate in water and make up to 100 ml.

reagents.name: Sodium acetate solution, 20 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 20 g sodium acetate in water and make up to 100 ml.

reagents.name: Xylenol orange indicator
reagents.prep: In a dropping bottle.

reagents.name: EDTA standard solution
reagents.prep: Standardized; its factor F (g of ZnO equal to 1 ml) is used in the calculation.

en.sampling: Take the FES dust sample as per the laboratory sampling practice and use the powdered, well-mixed sample.
procedure: Dissolution: Weigh 0.5 g of dust sample into a 250 ml beaker.
Add 15 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid with a pipette.
Add 5 ml concentrated nitric acid.
Cover the beaker with a watch glass.
Boil for 5 minutes on the hot plate.
Cool at room temperature for about 10 minutes.
Separation: Add 10 ml ammonium sulphate solution (30 percent) with a pipette.
Add 10 ml potassium fluoride solution (10 percent) with a pipette.
Add 35 ml ammonia solution with a measuring cylinder.
Boil for 10 minutes on the hot plate.
Cool to room temperature.
Add 10 ml ammonia solution with a measuring cylinder.
Make up: Filter the solution through a funnel into a 500 ml volumetric flask. Rinse the beaker and the filter paper with water into the flask, make up to the mark (500 ml) and mix.
Titration: Pipette 50 ml of this solution into a 250 ml conical flask.
Add one drop of methyl orange.
Add hydrochloric acid drop by drop until the colour turns pink.
Add ammonia solution drop by drop until the colour turns yellow.
Add 10 ml potassium fluoride solution (10 percent) with a pipette.
Add 10 ml sodium thiosulphate solution (10 percent) with a pipette.
Add 20 ml sodium acetate solution (20 percent).
Add a pinch of ascorbic acid with a spatula.
Add 3 drops of xylenol orange indicator.
Titrate with EDTA standard solution from the burette until the colour changes from pink/red to yellow. Note the burette reading (V).
en.end_point: Xylenol orange: pink/red to clear yellow.
calculation: ZnO, percent = V × F × 100 / W
where V = burette reading, ml of EDTA solution; F = EDTA factor, g of ZnO equal to 1 ml of EDTA solution; W = mass of sample in the aliquot = 0.5 × 50 / 500 = 0.05 g.
So, ZnO, percent = V × F × 2 000
Example: for 0.05 M EDTA, F = 0.05 × 81.38 / 1 000 = 0.004 069 g, and ZnO, percent = V × 8.138.
If zinc is needed as Zn: Zn, percent = ZnO percent × 0.803 4  (65.38 / 81.38).
en.reporting: Report ZnO percent. If the value is to be rounded off, round it as per IS 2.
notes: Potassium fluoride gives hydrofluoric acid in acid solution. Handle it with gloves and keep it in plastic bottles; do not let it stand long in glass.
Add the acids and boil in a fume hood.

This is a laboratory-developed method. Validate it before routine use (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1): recovery of a known zinc addition to a FES dust sample, repeatability on duplicates, and comparison with DM/QA/WI/46 or a reference material.
Zinc oxide factor: molecular mass of ZnO (81.38) / atomic mass of Zn (65.38) = 1.244 7.

hi.short_title: FES Dust में ZnO (NH3 पृथक्करण - EDTA)
hi.title: FES Dust में Zinc Oxide (ZnO) का निर्धारण — Ammonia द्वारा पृथक्करण और EDTA Titration (Xylenol Orange)
hi.purpose: Iron और दूसरी बाधक धातुओं को ammonia से हटाने के बाद, EDTA titration द्वारा FES (Fume Extraction System) dust में zinc oxide (ZnO) ज्ञात करना।
hi.scope: Steel Melting Shop की FES / filter dust। यह लैब की नियमित विधि है।
hi.reference: लैब विधि (Procedure of ZnO in Filter Dust); ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1 (लैब द्वारा विकसित विधियों का validation)।
hi.principle: Dust को hydrochloric और nitric acid में घोला जाता है। Ammonium sulphate और potassium fluoride डालकर फिर अधिक ammonia डाला जाता है: iron, aluminium और दूसरी धातुएँ hydroxide के रूप में, calcium और magnesium fluoride के रूप में और lead sulphate के रूप में नीचे बैठ जाते हैं, जबकि zinc, zinc–ammonia complex के रूप में घोल में रहता है। घोल को छानकर volume बनाया जाता है। Aliquot में methyl orange, hydrochloric acid और ammonia से pH ठीक किया जाता है, फिर sodium acetate से buffer किया जाता है। Potassium fluoride, aluminium को mask करता है, sodium thiosulphate, copper को mask करता है और ascorbic acid बचे हुए iron(III) को कम करता है। Zinc को xylenol orange indicator के साथ EDTA से titrate किया जाता है; रंग गुलाबी/लाल से पीला हो जाता है।
apparatus: Beaker, 250 ml, watch glass के साथ
Pipettes, 10 ml, 15 ml और 50 ml (और nitric acid के लिए 5 ml)
Dropping bottles (methyl orange, hydrochloric acid, ammonia solution, xylenol orange)

reagents.name: Ammonium sulphate solution, 30 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: 30 g ammonium sulphate पानी में घोलकर 100 ml बनाएँ।

reagents.name: Potassium fluoride solution, 10 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: 10 g potassium fluoride पानी में घोलकर 100 ml बनाएँ। Plastic की बोतल में रखें।

reagents.name: Methyl orange indicator
reagents.prep: Dropping bottle में।

reagents.name: Hydrochloric acid (pH ठीक करने के लिए)
reagents.prep: Dropping bottle में।

reagents.name: Sodium thiosulphate solution, 10 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: 10 g sodium thiosulphate पानी में घोलकर 100 ml बनाएँ।

reagents.name: Sodium acetate solution, 20 percent (m/v)
reagents.prep: 20 g sodium acetate पानी में घोलकर 100 ml बनाएँ।

reagents.name: Xylenol orange indicator
reagents.prep: Dropping bottle में।

reagents.name: EDTA standard solution
reagents.prep: Standardize किया हुआ; इसका factor F (1 ml के बराबर ZnO, g में) calculation में लिया जाता है।

hi.sampling: FES dust का नमूना लैब की sampling पद्धति के अनुसार लें और पाउडर किया हुआ, अच्छी तरह मिला हुआ नमूना प्रयोग करें।
procedure: घोलना: 0.5 g dust नमूना 250 ml beaker में तौलें।
Pipette से 15 ml concentrated hydrochloric acid डालें।
5 ml concentrated nitric acid डालें।
Beaker को watch glass से ढकें।
Hot plate पर 5 मिनट उबालें।
कमरे के तापमान पर लगभग 10 मिनट ठंडा करें।
पृथक्करण: Pipette से 10 ml ammonium sulphate solution (30 percent) डालें।
Pipette से 10 ml potassium fluoride solution (10 percent) डालें।
Measuring cylinder से 35 ml ammonia solution डालें।
Hot plate पर 10 मिनट उबालें।
कमरे के तापमान तक ठंडा करें।
Measuring cylinder से 10 ml ammonia solution डालें।
Volume बनाना: घोल को funnel से 500 ml volumetric flask में छानें। Beaker और filter paper को पानी से धोकर धोवन flask में लें, निशान तक (500 ml) भरें और मिलाएँ।
Titration: इस घोल का 50 ml pipette से 250 ml conical flask में लें।
Methyl orange की एक बूँद डालें।
रंग गुलाबी होने तक hydrochloric acid बूँद-बूँद डालें।
रंग पीला होने तक ammonia solution बूँद-बूँद डालें।
Pipette से 10 ml potassium fluoride solution (10 percent) डालें।
Pipette से 10 ml sodium thiosulphate solution (10 percent) डालें।
20 ml sodium acetate solution (20 percent) डालें।
Spatula से एक चुटकी ascorbic acid डालें।
Xylenol orange indicator की 3 बूँदें डालें।
Burette से EDTA standard solution से तब तक titrate करें जब तक रंग गुलाबी/लाल से पीला न हो जाए। Burette reading (V) नोट करें।
hi.end_point: Xylenol orange: गुलाबी/लाल से साफ पीला।
calculation: ZnO, प्रतिशत = V × F × 100 / W
जहाँ V = burette reading, EDTA solution (ml); F = EDTA factor, 1 ml EDTA solution के बराबर ZnO (g); W = aliquot में नमूने का द्रव्यमान = 0.5 × 50 / 500 = 0.05 g।
इसलिए, ZnO, प्रतिशत = V × F × 2 000
Zinc, Zn के रूप में चाहिए तो: Zn, प्रतिशत = ZnO प्रतिशत × 0.803 4  (65.38 / 81.38)।
hi.reporting: ZnO प्रतिशत रिपोर्ट करें। Round off करना हो तो IS 2 के अनुसार करें।
notes: Potassium fluoride, acid घोल में hydrofluoric acid बनाता है। इसे gloves पहनकर संभालें और plastic की बोतल में रखें; कांच में देर तक न रहने दें।
Acid डालना और उबालना fume hood में करें।

यह लैब द्वारा विकसित विधि है। नियमित उपयोग से पहले इसका validation करें (ISO/IEC 17025:2017, cl. 7.2.2.1): FES dust नमूने में ज्ञात zinc मिलाकर recovery, duplicates पर repeatability, और DM/QA/WI/46 या reference material से तुलना।
Zinc oxide factor: ZnO का आणविक द्रव्यमान (81.38) / Zn का परमाणु द्रव्यमान (65.38) = 1.244 7।

keywords: remix redex aluminium dross al2o3 alumina total deoxidiser powder total al as al2o3 in remix / redex

en.short_title: Total Al as Al2O3 in Remix / Redex
en.title: Determination of Total Aluminium (as Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>) in Remix / Redex Powder by EDTA Method — adapted from IS 12107 (Part 3) : 1987
en.purpose: To find total aluminium, expressed as Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>, in remix / redex powder by the EDTA method of IS 12107 (Part 3) : 1987.
en.scope: IS 12107 (Part 3) : 1987 gives a method for aluminium (as Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>) in alumino silicate refractory materials (clause 1). Its use for remix / redex (aluminium dross based deoxidiser powders) is a laboratory adaptation, i.e. a standard method used outside its intended scope. Validate it before use as required by ISO/IEC 17025 : 2017, clause 7.2.2.1. The result is total aluminium (metallic Al + Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>) expressed as Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>, as calculated in the IS.
en.reference: IS 12107 (Part 3) : 1987 (Reaffirmed 2022), Clauses 1, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3; IS 12107 (Part 1) : 1987, Clauses 2 and 3; ISO/IEC 17025 : 2017, Clause 7.2.2.1
en.principle: Boil the solution with excess EDTA. Aluminium (and iron and titanium, if present) forms a complex with EDTA. Back titrate the excess EDTA with standard zinc acetate solution at pH 5.3, using xylenol orange indicator. Then boil with sodium fluoride: the aluminium EDTA complex (and titanium EDTA complex, if present) releases EDTA. Titrate this EDTA with standard zinc acetate solution; it gives the aluminium and titanium in the solution. Correct for titania (2.1).
apparatus: Crusher with hardened tool steel faces, magnet, agate mortar, IS Sieve 15 (aperture 75 µm, see IS 460 (Part 1)) (IS 12107 (Part 1), 2.2)
Glass weighing bottle and air oven, 105 to 110 °C (IS 12107 (Part 1), 2.3)

reagents.name: Quality of reagents (IS 12107 (Part 1), 3)
reagents.prep: Use analytical grade reagents and distilled water, unless stated otherwise. (This clause applies to all parts of IS 12107.)

reagents.name: EDTA solution, 0.025 M (2.2.1)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 9.31 g of EDTA (disodium salt) (C<sub>10</sub>H<sub>14</sub>N<sub>2</sub>Na<sub>2</sub>O<sub>8</sub>.2H<sub>2</sub>O) in 1 litre of water.

reagents.name: Methyl orange indicator solution (2.2.2)
reagents.prep: 0.05 percent (m/v) in ethanol.

reagents.name: Buffer solution, pH 5.3 (2.2.4)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 21.5 g of sodium acetate with 2 ml of glacial acetic acid in 300 ml of water. Dilute to 1 litre.

reagents.name: Xylenol orange indicator solution, 0.1 percent (m/v) (2.2.5)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 0.1 g of xylenol orange indicator in 100 ml of water containing 2-3 drops of dilute hydrochloric acid (1 : 1).

reagents.name: Standard zinc acetate solution, 0.025 M (2.2.6)
reagents.prep: Dissolve 5.50 g of zinc acetate [Zn(CH<sub>3</sub>COO)<sub>2</sub>.2H<sub>2</sub>O] in 1 000 ml of water containing 25 ml of buffer solution (pH 5.3). Standardize against standard aluminium solution by the aluminium method of 2.3.1.

reagents.name: Standard aluminium solution, 0.025 M (2.2.6.1)
reagents.prep: Wash an aluminium foil with absolute alcohol and dry in a desiccator. Weigh 0.674 5 g of the foil into a beaker with 25 ml of water and 25 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid. Heat to dissolve the metal. Cool and dilute to 1 000 ml in a volumetric flask (1 ml = 0.001 275 g of Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>).

reagents.name: Sodium fluoride (2.2.7)
reagents.prep: Solid.

en.sampling:
Sampling (IS 12107 (Part 1), 2.1): As per IS 1528 (Part 7).
Laboratory sample (IS 12107 (Part 1), 2.2): Crush the sample in a crusher with hardened tool steel faces. Take care that steel particles from the equipment do not contaminate the sample during crushing and grinding. After quartering, carefully screen 20 g of the sample with a magnet to remove loose iron particles. Then grind in an agate mortar until it fully passes IS Sieve 15 (aperture 75 µm).
Test sample (IS 12107 (Part 1), 2.3): Dry enough laboratory sample in a glass weighing bottle in an air oven at 105 to 110 °C.
Main solution: Prepare the main solution from a weighed mass M (g) of test sample as per 2.3.3 of IS 12107 (Part 2) : 1987 (Determination of silica). The main solution is 500 ml (factor 500 in 2.3.2).
procedure: (cl. 2.3.1) Transfer 25 ml of main solution [see 2.3.3 of IS 12107 (Part 2) : 1987] to a 250-ml conical flask.
Add 35 ml of EDTA solution and 2-3 drops of methyl orange indicator solution.
Add dilute ammonia solution drop by drop until the colour just turns yellow.
Add 15 ml of buffer solution. Boil for 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature.
Add 5-6 drops of xylenol orange indicator. Titrate with standard zinc acetate solution to just pink colour (this first titration back titrates the excess EDTA).
Add 1 g of sodium fluoride, then 2-3 drops of dilute hydrochloric acid.
Boil again for 5 minutes. Cool to room temperature.
Add 5 ml of buffer solution. Titrate the released EDTA with standard zinc acetate solution, using 5-6 drops of xylenol orange indicator, to pink end point.
Record the second titre (V ml). It equals the titanium and aluminium.

Standardization of zinc acetate (2.2.6): Standardize the zinc acetate solution against the standard aluminium solution (1 ml = 0.001 275 g of Al2O3) by the method of 2.3.1. Get E, the equivalent Al2O3 in g/ml of zinc acetate solution.
en.end_point: Pink colour with xylenol orange (pH 5.3), for both the back titration of excess EDTA and the titration of EDTA released by sodium fluoride (2.3.1).
calculation: Aluminium (as Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>), percent by mass = (V × E × 500 × 100) / (25 × M) − (0.673 8 × T)  (2.3.2)
where
V = ml of zinc acetate used (second titre),
E = equivalent Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> in g/ml of zinc acetate solution,
M = mass in g of sample taken, and
T = percent of TiO<sub>2</sub> by mass [value found by the method of IS 12107 (Part 5) : 1987 'Determination of titanium'].
Stoichiometric conversion (not from the IS): Where metallic Al (Alm) is known: Al2O3 (oxide only), % = Al2O3 (total), % − Alm, % × 1.889 (1.889 = Al2O3/2Al = 101.96/53.96, stoichiometric).
notes: Laboratory adaptation: IS 12107 (Part 3) is written for alumino silicate refractory materials. Validate the method before routine use on remix / redex powder (ISO/IEC 17025 : 2017, 7.2.2.1: the laboratory shall validate non-standard methods, laboratory-developed methods and standard methods used outside their intended scope or otherwise modified).
Iron and titanium also form complexes with EDTA (2.1). The second titre equals titanium and aluminium; titania is corrected by the term 0.673 8 × T (2.3.2).

This method does not find metallic aluminium. JIS G 2404 : 2022 (Methods for chemical analysis of aluminium dross for iron and steel making) has methods for metallic aluminium (cl. 5) and aluminium oxide (cl. 10); the full text of JIS G 2404 is needed to add them. Metallic aluminium: see DM/QA/WI/37 (adapted from IS 438 : 2006, Annex K). Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> (oxide only) can then be found with the stoichiometric relation in Calculation.

रंग ठीक yellow होने तक dilute ammonia solution बूँद-बूँद डालें।
15 ml buffer solution डालें। 5 minutes उबालें। कमरे के तापमान तक ठंडा करें।
5-6 बूँद xylenol orange indicator डालें। Standard zinc acetate solution से ठीक pink रंग तक titrate करें (यह पहला titration अतिरिक्त EDTA का back titration है)।
1 g sodium fluoride डालें, फिर 2-3 बूँद dilute hydrochloric acid डालें।
फिर से 5 minutes उबालें। कमरे के तापमान तक ठंडा करें।
5 ml buffer solution डालें। मुक्त हुए EDTA को 5-6 बूँद xylenol orange indicator के साथ standard zinc acetate solution से pink end point तक titrate करें।
दूसरा titre लिखें (V ml)। यह titanium और aluminium के बराबर है।

Zinc acetate का standardization (2.2.6): 2.3.1 की विधि से zinc acetate solution को standard aluminium solution (1 ml = 0.001 275 g Al2O3) के विरुद्ध standardize करें। E प्राप्त करें, अर्थात् zinc acetate solution के g/ml में equivalent Al2O3।
hi.end_point: Xylenol orange (pH 5.3) के साथ pink रंग — अतिरिक्त EDTA के back titration और sodium fluoride से मुक्त EDTA के titration, दोनों के लिए (2.3.1)।
calculation: Aluminium (Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> के रूप में), percent by mass = (V × E × 500 × 100) / (25 × M) − (0.673 8 × T)  (2.3.2)
जहाँ
V = लगा zinc acetate, ml में (दूसरा titre),
E = zinc acetate solution का equivalent Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>, g/ml में,
M = लिए गए नमूने का भार, g में, और
T = TiO<sub>2</sub> का percent by mass [IS 12107 (Part 5) : 1987 'Determination of titanium' की विधि से प्राप्त मान]।
Stoichiometric रूपांतरण (IS से नहीं): जहाँ metallic Al (Alm) ज्ञात हो: Al2O3 (केवल oxide), % = Al2O3 (कुल), % − Alm, % × 1.889 (1.889 = Al2O3/2Al = 101.96/53.96, stoichiometric)।
notes: Laboratory adaptation: IS 12107 (Part 3) alumino silicate refractory सामग्री के लिए लिखा गया है। Remix / redex powder पर routine प्रयोग से पहले विधि validate करें (ISO/IEC 17025 : 2017, 7.2.2.1: laboratory को non-standard methods, laboratory-developed methods और इच्छित scope से बाहर प्रयोग या बदली गई standard methods को validate करना होगा)।
Iron और titanium भी EDTA से complex बनाते हैं (2.1)। दूसरा titre titanium और aluminium के बराबर है; titania का correction 0.673 8 × T पद से होता है (2.3.2)।

यह विधि metallic aluminium ज्ञात नहीं करती। JIS G 2404 : 2022 (Methods for chemical analysis of aluminium dross for iron and steel making) में metallic aluminium (cl. 5) और aluminium oxide (cl. 10) की विधियाँ हैं; इन्हें जोड़ने के लिए JIS G 2404 का पूरा पाठ चाहिए। Metallic aluminium: देखें DM/QA/WI/37 (IS 438 : 2006, Annex K से अनुकूलित)। फिर Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> (केवल oxide) गणना में दिए stoichiometric संबंध से निकाला जा सकता है।

en.title: Sampling of Sodium Silicate (Solid and Liquid), Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity as per IS 381 : 2024
en.purpose: To draw representative samples of sodium silicate (solid and liquid) from a lot, prepare individual and composite samples, and judge the lot against Table 1 of IS 381 : 2024.
en.scope: IS 381 : 2024 gives requirements and method of sampling for sodium silicate, in solid and liquid forms, for use in various industries (IS 381, cl. 1). Grades: neutral and alkaline (cl. 3). Liquid, neutral: Type 1 — for pharmaceutical and toilet preparations; Type 2 — for adhesive and other purposes (cl. 4.1). Liquid, alkaline: Type 1, Type 2 and Type 3, for soap, detergent, textile, welding electrode and cement industries (cl. 4.2). The tests themselves are done as per IS 14212 : 1995 (separate WIs).
en.reference: IS 381 : 2024 (Third Revision), Clauses 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, Table 1, Annex B (B-1 to B-5, Table 3)
apparatus: Suitable, clean and dry sample containers with proper closures (B-1.4)
Random number tables (IS 4905) for random selection of drums (B-2.3)
en.sampling: Take about 500 g (solid) or about 300 g (liquid) from each selected drum (B-3.1.1). Composite sample: about 300 g, divided into three equal parts (B-3.1.3). Number of drums: Table 3 (B-2.2).
procedure: General (B-1): Follow these precautions while drawing, preparing, storing and handling samples (B-1.1).
Protect the samples, sampling instruments and sample containers from contamination (B-1.2).
Mix the material well before drawing the sample (B-1.3).
Put the samples in suitable, clean and dry containers with proper closures (B-1.4). After filling, seal each container air-tight and mark it with full details of sampling (B-1.5).

Lot (B-2.1): All containers in a single consignment of one grade from a single batch of manufacture form a lot. If a consignment has different grades or batches, separate the containers and group them into lots as above.
Test samples from each lot to check conformity of the material to the specification (B-2.1.1).
Number of drums (B-2.2): Select the number (n) of containers from a lot as per the lot size (N), from col (2) and col (3) of Table 3.
Choose the drums for sampling at random, preferably with random number tables. To make sure selection is random, the procedure of IS 4905 may be followed (B-2.3).

Drawing the sample (B-3.1.1): Mix the contents of each selected drum well and then let the liquid come to rest (as printed in IS for the solid). With a suitable sampling instrument, draw small portions of sodium silicate (solid) from different parts of each selected drum. The total from each drum must be about 500 g.
For liquid, mix the contents of the drum well, let the liquid come to rest, and then draw a sample of about 300 g (B-3.1.1).
Individual samples (B-3.1.2): Put the portions from each drum into separate sample containers. These filled containers are the individual samples.
Composite sample (B-3.1.3): Take a small but equal quantity from each individual sample. Mix them all well to make a composite sample of about 300 g.
If sieving is needed, sieve the portions from each individual sample separately. Make the composite sample only from the sieved material (B-3.1.3).
Divide the composite sample into three equal parts: one for the purchaser, one for the supplier and the third as referee sample (B-3.1.3).

Referee sample (B-3.2): The referee sample is the composite sample (B-3.1.3) plus a set of individual test samples (B-3.1.2) marked for this purpose. It must carry the seals of the purchaser and the supplier. Keep it at a place agreed by the purchaser and the supplier. Use it in case of dispute between them.

Number of tests (B-4.1): Test total soluble silicates and the ratio of total alkalinity to total soluble silica on any three individual samples, chosen at random from those prepared as per B-3.1.2. Use the same samples for both tests.
Test all other characteristics on the composite sample (B-4.2).

Description check (cl. 5.1): The material must be clear and free from dirt and other visible impurities. Liquid sodium silicate must be a thick, viscid, translucent mass of water, white or slightly grey colour (5.1.1). Solid sodium silicate must be glassy lumps of pale grey or green colour; for special needs, particle size as agreed between the purchaser and the supplier (5.1.2).
Requirements (cl. 5.2): The material must also meet Table 1 when tested by the methods of IS 14212 (see the separate test WIs).

tables.after: Column (2) to (10) numbering as in IS 381. Col (10) gives the relevant clause of IS 14212 for each test (IS 381, cl. 5.2). Annex A of IS 381 (instrumental methods) applies to Table 1, Sl No. (vi), (viii) and (ix).

en.reporting:
Criteria for conformity (B-5): B-5.1 For the characteristics tested on individual samples (B-4.1), every result on each individual sample must meet the matching requirement of Table 1 for the lot to conform. B-5.2 For the other characteristics of Table 1, the result on the composite sample must meet the requirement. B-5.3 Declare the lot as conforming to the specification only if both B-5.1 and B-5.2 are met.
Rounding (IS 381, Foreword): To decide compliance, round off the final value (observed or calculated) as per IS 2 : 2022. Keep the same number of significant places as in the specified value.
notes: Table 1 limits for loss on ignition apply to solid material only; viscosity, chloride and sulphate apply to liquid, neutral, Type 1 only; relative density applies to liquid only.

Packing (IS 381, 6.1): air-tight mild steel drums of capacity as agreed between the purchaser and the supplier. Marking (6.2): name and grade of the material; source of manufacture; gross and net mass of the material; year of manufacture; and lot number so that the batch of manufacture can be traced from the records.

Table 1, col (10) of IS 381 gives 'A-7 or A-12' for total soluble silicates (Sl No. iii). In IS 14212, A-7 is total alkalinity, A-8 is total soluble silicates (A-6 + A-7) and A-12 is viscosity. See the test WI for the method used.

hi.title: IS 381 : 2024 के अनुसार Sodium Silicate (ठोस और तरल) का नमूना लेना, परीक्षणों की संख्या और अनुरूपता के मानदंड
hi.purpose: Lot से sodium silicate (ठोस और तरल) के प्रतिनिधि नमूने लेना, individual और composite samples तैयार करना, और lot को IS 381 : 2024 की Table 1 के विरुद्ध परखना।
hi.scope: IS 381 : 2024 विभिन्न उद्योगों में उपयोग के लिए ठोस और तरल रूप में sodium silicate की आवश्यकताएँ और नमूना लेने की विधि देता है (IS 381, cl. 1)। Grades: neutral और alkaline (cl. 3)। तरल, neutral: Type 1 — pharmaceutical और toilet preparations के लिए; Type 2 — adhesive और अन्य उपयोगों के लिए (cl. 4.1)। तरल, alkaline: Type 1, Type 2 और Type 3, soap, detergent, textile, welding electrode और cement उद्योगों के लिए (cl. 4.2)। परीक्षण स्वयं IS 14212 : 1995 के अनुसार किए जाते हैं (अलग WIs)।
hi.reference: IS 381 : 2024 (Third Revision), Clauses 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, Table 1, Annex B (B-1 to B-5, Table 3)
apparatus: उपयुक्त, साफ और सूखे sample containers, सही ढक्कन सहित (B-1.4)
Drums के random चयन के लिए random number tables (IS 4905) (B-2.3)
hi.sampling: हर चुने drum से लगभग 500 g (ठोस) या लगभग 300 g (तरल) लें (B-3.1.1)। Composite sample: लगभग 300 g, तीन बराबर भागों में बाँटा गया (B-3.1.3)। Drums की संख्या: Table 3 (B-2.2)।
procedure: सामान्य (B-1): नमूने लेते, तैयार करते, रखते और संभालते समय ये सावधानियाँ अपनाएँ (B-1.1)।
नमूनों, sampling instruments और sample containers को दूषण से बचाएँ (B-1.2)।
नमूना लेने से पहले माल को अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ (B-1.3)।
नमूनों को उपयुक्त, साफ और सूखे containers में सही ढक्कन के साथ रखें (B-1.4)। भरने के बाद हर container को air-tight seal करें और उस पर नमूना लेने का पूरा विवरण लिखें (B-1.5)।

Lot (B-2.1): एक consignment में एक grade के, एक ही batch of manufacture के सभी containers एक lot बनाते हैं। यदि consignment में अलग-अलग grades या batches हों, तो containers को अलग करके ऊपर के अनुसार lots में बाँटें।
Specification के अनुरूपता जाँचने के लिए हर lot के नमूनों का परीक्षण करें (B-2.1.1)।
Drums की संख्या (B-2.2): lot से containers की संख्या (n) lot size (N) के अनुसार Table 3 के col (2) और col (3) से चुनें।
नमूने के लिए drums random चुनें, अच्छा हो कि random number tables से। random चयन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए IS 4905 की विधि अपनाई जा सकती है (B-2.3)।

नमूना लेना (B-3.1.1): हर चुने drum का माल अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ और फिर तरल को स्थिर होने दें (ठोस के लिए IS में ऐसा ही छपा है)। उपयुक्त sampling instrument से हर चुने drum के अलग-अलग भागों से sodium silicate (ठोस) के छोटे भाग लें। हर drum से कुल लगभग 500 g हो।
तरल के लिए drum का माल अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ, तरल को स्थिर होने दें, फिर लगभग 300 g नमूना लें (B-3.1.1)।
Individual samples (B-3.1.2): हर drum से लिए भाग अलग-अलग sample containers में रखें। ये भरे containers individual samples हैं।
Composite sample (B-3.1.3): हर individual sample से थोड़ी परंतु बराबर मात्रा लें। सबको अच्छी तरह मिलाकर लगभग 300 g का composite sample बनाएँ।
यदि छानना आवश्यक हो, तो हर individual sample के भाग अलग-अलग छानें। composite sample केवल छने हुए माल से बनाएँ (B-3.1.3)।
Composite sample को तीन बराबर भागों में बाँटें: एक purchaser के लिए, एक supplier के लिए और तीसरा referee sample (B-3.1.3)।

Referee sample (B-3.2): referee sample में composite sample (B-3.1.3) और इस उद्देश्य के लिए चिह्नित individual test samples (B-3.1.2) का एक सेट होता है। इस पर purchaser और supplier दोनों की seals हों। इसे purchaser और supplier द्वारा तय स्थान पर रखें। दोनों के बीच विवाद होने पर इसका उपयोग करें।

परीक्षणों की संख्या (B-4.1): total soluble silicates और total alkalinity तथा total soluble silica के अनुपात का परीक्षण B-3.1.2 के अनुसार बने individual samples में से random चुने किन्हीं तीन पर करें। दोनों परीक्षणों के लिए वही नमूने उपयोग करें।
अन्य सभी गुणों का परीक्षण composite sample पर करें (B-4.2)।

विवरण जाँच (cl. 5.1): माल साफ हो और धूल तथा अन्य दिखने वाली अशुद्धियों से मुक्त हो। तरल sodium silicate गाढ़ा, चिपचिपा, पारभासी (translucent) पानी जैसा द्रव्यमान हो, सफेद या हल्के भूरे रंग का (5.1.1)। ठोस sodium silicate हल्के भूरे या हरे रंग के कांच जैसे टुकड़ों के रूप में हो; विशेष आवश्यकता के लिए कण आकार purchaser और supplier के बीच तय अनुसार (5.1.2)।
आवश्यकताएँ (cl. 5.2): IS 14212 की विधियों से परखने पर माल Table 1 को भी पूरा करे (अलग परीक्षण WIs देखें)।

hi.reporting:
अनुरूपता के मानदंड (B-5): B-5.1 individual samples पर परखे गए गुणों (B-4.1) के लिए, lot के अनुरूप होने हेतु हर individual sample का हर परिणाम Table 1 की संबंधित आवश्यकता पूरी करे। B-5.2 Table 1 के अन्य गुणों के लिए composite sample का परिणाम आवश्यकता पूरी करे। B-5.3 lot को specification के अनुरूप तभी घोषित करें जब B-5.1 और B-5.2 दोनों पूरे हों।
Rounding (IS 381, Foreword): अनुपालन तय करने के लिए अंतिम मान (देखा गया या गणना किया गया) IS 2 : 2022 के अनुसार round off करें। significant places उतने ही रखें जितने निर्धारित मान में हैं।
notes: Table 1 में ignition पर कमी की सीमा केवल ठोस माल पर लागू है; viscosity, chloride और sulphate केवल तरल, neutral, Type 1 पर लागू हैं; relative density केवल तरल पर लागू है।

Packing (IS 381, 6.1): air-tight mild steel drums, क्षमता purchaser और supplier के बीच तय अनुसार। Marking (6.2): माल का नाम और grade; निर्माण का स्रोत; माल का gross और net द्रव्यमान; निर्माण का वर्ष; और lot number ताकि records से batch of manufacture का पता लगाया जा सके।

IS 381 की Table 1, col (10) में total soluble silicates (Sl No. iii) के लिए 'A-7 or A-12' दिया है। IS 14212 में A-7 total alkalinity है, A-8 total soluble silicates (A-6 + A-7) है और A-12 viscosity है। उपयोग की गई विधि के लिए परीक्षण WI देखें।

en.title: Determination of Matter Insoluble in Water in Sodium Silicate (IS 14212, A-3)
en.purpose: To find the matter insoluble in water in sodium silicate (liquid and solid).
en.scope: Sodium silicate, liquid and solid, all grades and types of IS 381 : 2024 (Table 1, Sl No. i). Method: IS 14212 : 1995, A-3.
en.reference: IS 14212 : 1995 (Reaffirmed 2021), Annex A, cl. A-1.1, A-2.2, A-3.1, A-3.2; IS 381 : 2024, cl. 5.2, Table 1 (Sl No. i), Annex B
apparatus: For solid material (A-2.2): autoclave, 4 kg/cm<super>2</super>; 150 micron IS Sieve (see IS 460 : 1985) for the neutral type

reagents.name: Quality of reagents (IS 14212, A-1.1)
reagents.prep: Use pure chemicals and reagent grade water (see IS 1070 : 1992), unless stated otherwise. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that do not contain impurities which affect the result.

reagents.name: Freshly boiled water
reagents.prep: For dissolving and washing.

reagents.name: Phenolphthalein
reagents.prep: Used to check that the washings are free from alkali (no colour).

en.sampling: Draw and prepare the sample as per DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, Annex B). Do this test on the composite sample (IS 381, B-4.2).
procedure: Weigh accurately about 25 g of the material into a 400-ml beaker.
Dissolve it in about 250 ml freshly boiled water. For solid material, prepare the solution as under A-2.2 (see Note 1).
Filter by applying suction through a tared Gooch crucible.
Wash the beaker and the residue with freshly boiled water until free from alkali (washings give no colour with phenolphthalein).
Dry the Gooch crucible in an oven maintained at 110 ± 5 °C.
Cool in a desiccator and weigh.
Repeat heating and cooling until constant mass is obtained.

tables.title: Requirement — IS 381 : 2024, Table 1 (Sl No. i)
rows: Method of Test [Ref to Clause in IS 14212] (10)
Matter insoluble in water, percent by mass, Max
tables.after: Column numbering as in IS 381, Table 1. '–' = not specified for that grade/type.

calculation: Matter insoluble in water, percent by weight = 100 × M<sub>1</sub> / M (A-3.2)
where M<sub>1</sub> = mass in g of the residue, and M = mass in g of the material taken for the test.
en.reporting: Round off the final value as per IS 2 : 2022. Keep the same number of significant places as in the specified value of IS 381 (IS 381, Foreword). Judge conformity of the lot as per DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, B-5).

en.title: Determination of Relative Density at 27/27 °C of Sodium Silicate (Liquid) by Pyknometer (IS 14212, A-5)
en.purpose: To find the relative density at 27/27 °C of liquid sodium silicate.
en.scope: Sodium silicate, liquid (neutral Type 1 and Type 2; alkaline Type 1, Type 2 and Type 3) of IS 381 : 2024 (Table 1, Sl No. ii). Not specified for solid material. Method: IS 14212 : 1995, A-5.
en.reference: IS 14212 : 1995 (Reaffirmed 2021), Annex A, cl. A-1.1, A-5.1, A-5.2.1, A-5.2.2, A-5.3; IS 381 : 2024, cl. 5.2, Table 1 (Sl No. ii), Annex B
apparatus: Pyknometer, wide neck — the channel of the stopper not being a capillary tube (see Types 5 and 6 of IS 5717 : 1991)

reagents.name: Quality of reagents (IS 14212, A-1.1)
reagents.prep: Use pure chemicals and reagent grade water (see IS 1070 : 1992), unless stated otherwise. 'Pure chemicals' means chemicals that do not contain impurities which affect the result.

reagents.name: Water
reagents.prep: Boiled and cooled to 27 ± 0.5 °C.

reagents.name: Alcohol or acetone
reagents.prep: For rinsing the pyknometer.

en.sampling: Draw and prepare the sample as per DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, Annex B). Do this test on the composite sample (IS 381, B-4.2).
procedure: Mass of water (A-5.2.1): Clean and dry the pyknometer with its stopper. Weigh to the nearest 0.001 g.
Fill the pyknometer with water boiled and cooled to 27 ± 0.5 °C. Place it in the water-bath controlled at 27 ± 0.5 °C.
Allow at least 30 minutes for the temperature to reach equilibrium.
Remove the pyknometer from the water-bath, holding it by the neck. Stopper it, wipe the outside and remove the excess water from the upper part of the stopper.
Weigh the pyknometer and stopper to the nearest 0.001 g. Find the mass of water (M) by difference.
Mass of sample (A-5.2.2): Empty the pyknometer. Rinse it with alcohol or acetone and let it dry.
Fill it with the sample, previously adjusted to 27 ± 0.5 °C. Avoid air bubbles, especially when the solution is very viscous.
Place the pyknometer in the water-bath at 27 ± 0.5 °C. Allow at least 30 minutes for the temperature to reach equilibrium.
Weigh as in A-5.2.1. Find the mass of sample (M<sub>1</sub>) by difference.

tables.title: Requirement — IS 381 : 2024, Table 1 (Sl No. ii)
rows: Method of Test [Ref to Clause in IS 14212] (10)
tables.after: Column numbering as in IS 381, Table 1. '–' = not specified for that grade/type.

calculation: Relative density, 27/27 °C = (M<sub>1</sub> / M) × d (A-5.3)
where M<sub>1</sub> = mass in g of the sample, M = mass in g of the same volume of water, and d = density of water at 27 °C.
en.reporting: Round off the final value as per IS 2 : 2022. Keep the same number of significant places as in the specified value of IS 381 (IS 381, Foreword). Judge conformity of the lot as per DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, B-5).
notes: If the pyknometer gets soiled on the outside by the solution under test, wash it with water at a temperature slightly below 27 °C and then wipe it (A-5.2 Note).
IS 14212, A-4 (specific gravity by Twaddell hydrometer at 15.5 °C) is not called by IS 381 Table 1; relative density is by A-5.
Relative density is specified for liquid material only (IS 381, Table 1).

hi.title: Pyknometer द्वारा सोडियम सिलिकेट (द्रव) का 27/27 °C पर आपेक्षिक घनत्व ज्ञात करना (IS 14212, A-5)
hi.purpose: द्रव सोडियम सिलिकेट का 27/27 °C पर आपेक्षिक घनत्व (relative density) ज्ञात करना।
hi.scope: IS 381 : 2024 का द्रव सोडियम सिलिकेट (न्यूट्रल Type 1 और Type 2; एल्कलाइन Type 1, Type 2 और Type 3) (Table 1, Sl No. ii)। ठोस पदार्थ के लिए निर्धारित नहीं। विधि: IS 14212 : 1995, A-5।
hi.reference: IS 14212 : 1995 (Reaffirmed 2021), Annex A, cl. A-1.1, A-5.1, A-5.2.1, A-5.2.2, A-5.3; IS 381 : 2024, cl. 5.2, Table 1 (Sl No. ii), Annex B
apparatus: Pyknometer, चौड़े मुँह वाला — stopper का channel capillary tube न हो (देखें IS 5717 : 1991 के Types 5 और 6)

reagents.name: अभिकर्मकों की गुणवत्ता (IS 14212, A-1.1)
reagents.prep: जब तक अलग से न कहा गया हो, शुद्ध रसायन और reagent grade water (देखें IS 1070 : 1992) प्रयोग करें। 'शुद्ध रसायन' का अर्थ है ऐसे रसायन जिनमें परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाली अशुद्धियाँ न हों।

reagents.name: पानी
reagents.prep: उबालकर 27 ± 0.5 °C तक ठंडा किया हुआ।

reagents.name: Alcohol या acetone
reagents.prep: Pyknometer को खंगालने (rinse) के लिए।

hi.sampling: नमूना DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, Annex B) के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें। यह परीक्षण composite sample पर करें (IS 381, B-4.2)।
procedure: पानी का द्रव्यमान (A-5.2.1): Pyknometer को stopper सहित साफ करें और सुखाएँ। 0.001 g तक तौलें।
Pyknometer में उबालकर 27 ± 0.5 °C तक ठंडा किया पानी भरें। इसे 27 ± 0.5 °C पर नियंत्रित water-bath में रखें।
तापमान को संतुलन (equilibrium) तक आने के लिए कम से कम 30 मिनट दें।
Pyknometer को गर्दन से पकड़कर water-bath से निकालें। stopper लगाएँ, बाहर से पोंछें और stopper के ऊपरी भाग से अतिरिक्त पानी हटाएँ।
Pyknometer और stopper को 0.001 g तक तौलें। अंतर से पानी का द्रव्यमान (M) ज्ञात करें।
नमूने का द्रव्यमान (A-5.2.2): Pyknometer खाली करें। इसे alcohol या acetone से खंगालें और सूखने दें।
इसमें पहले से 27 ± 0.5 °C पर लाया गया नमूना भरें। हवा के बुलबुले न बनने दें, विशेषकर जब विलयन बहुत गाढ़ा (viscous) हो।
Pyknometer को 27 ± 0.5 °C वाले water-bath में रखें। तापमान को संतुलन तक आने के लिए कम से कम 30 मिनट दें।
A-5.2.1 की तरह तौलें। अंतर से नमूने का द्रव्यमान (M<sub>1</sub>) ज्ञात करें।

calculation: आपेक्षिक घनत्व, 27/27 °C = (M<sub>1</sub> / M) × d (A-5.3)
जहाँ M<sub>1</sub> = नमूने का द्रव्यमान, g में, M = उतने ही आयतन पानी का द्रव्यमान, g में, और d = 27 °C पर पानी का घनत्व।
hi.reporting: अंतिम मान को IS 2 : 2022 के अनुसार round off करें। IS 381 में दिए निर्धारित मान जितने ही significant places रखें (IS 381, Foreword)। लॉट की अनुरूपता DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, B-5) के अनुसार तय करें।

आपेक्षिक घनत्व केवल द्रव पदार्थ के लिए निर्धारित है (IS 381, Table 1)।

en.title: Determination of Total Alkalinity (as Na<sub>2</sub>O) in Sodium Silicate by Titration — Method A (IS 14212, A-7)
en.purpose: To find the total alkalinity, as sodium oxide (Na<sub>2</sub>O), of sodium silicate. The result is used for total soluble silicates and the Na<sub>2</sub>O : SiO<sub>2</sub> ratio.
en.scope: Sodium silicate, liquid and solid, of IS 381 : 2024 (used for Table 1, Sl No. iii and iv). Method: IS 14212 : 1995, A-7 (Method A).
en.principle: Titrate the total alkalinity of a test portion with a standard volumetric solution of hydrochloric acid, using methyl orange as indicator (A-7.1).

reagents.name: Quality of reagents (A-7.2.1)
reagents.prep: Use only reagents of recognized analytical grade and only distilled water or water of equivalent purity.

reagents.name: Hydrochloric acid, 1 N standard volumetric solution (A-7.2.1 a)
Methyl orange, 0.5 g/l solution (A-7.2.1 b)
reagents.prep: Methyl orange may be replaced by any other indicator having the end-point in the same pH range.

en.sampling: Draw and prepare the sample as per DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, Annex B). For total soluble silicates and the Na<sub>2</sub>O : SiO<sub>2</sub> ratio, do this test on any three individual samples chosen at random; use the same samples for both tests (IS 381, B-4.1).
procedure: Weigh, to the nearest 0.01 g, 10 ± 1 g of the test sample.
Put the test portion in a 250-ml one-mark volumetric flask. Dissolve with water, dilute to the mark and mix.
Take a volume of this solution that needs about 20 ml of the standard hydrochloric acid solution for neutralization.
Add 5 drops of the methyl orange solution.
Titrate with the standard volumetric hydrochloric acid solution until the indicator changes from yellow to orange-pink (V).
en.end_point: Methyl orange: yellow to orange-pink.

tables.title: Requirement — IS 381 : 2024, Table 1 (Sl No. iii, iv)
rows: Method of Test [Ref to Clause in IS 14212] (10)
Total soluble silicates, percent by mass, Min
Ratio of total alkalinity (as Na<sub>2</sub>O) to total soluble silica (as SiO<sub>2</sub>) (Na<sub>2</sub>O : SiO<sub>2</sub>)
tables.after: Column numbering as in IS 381, Table 1. '–' = not specified for that grade/type.

calculation: Sodium oxide (Na<sub>2</sub>O), percent by mass = V × (100/m) × 0.031 0 = 3.10 × V / m (A-7.2.3)

where V = volume, in ml, of the standard volumetric hydrochloric acid solution used for the titration; m = mass, in g, of the test portion (or the mass, in g, of test portion contained in the aliquot of the test solution used); 0.031 0 = mass, in g, of sodium oxide corresponding to 1 ml of exactly 1 N hydrochloric acid solution.
If the concentration of the standard volumetric solution is not exactly as specified, make a suitable correction.
en.reporting: Round off the final value as per IS 2 : 2022. Keep the same number of significant places as in the specified value of IS 381 (IS 381, Foreword). Judge conformity of the lot as per DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, B-5).
notes: Table 1 of IS 381 has no separate limit for total alkalinity. Use the Na<sub>2</sub>O result with the SiO<sub>2</sub> result to calculate total soluble silicates (A-8) and the Na<sub>2</sub>O : SiO<sub>2</sub> ratio (A-9) — see DM/QA/WI/54.

hi.title: अनुमापन द्वारा सोडियम सिलिकेट में कुल क्षारीयता (Na<sub>2</sub>O के रूप में) ज्ञात करना — Method A (IS 14212, A-7)
hi.purpose: सोडियम सिलिकेट की कुल क्षारीयता, sodium oxide (Na<sub>2</sub>O) के रूप में, ज्ञात करना। परिणाम कुल घुलनशील सिलिकेट और Na<sub>2</sub>O : SiO<sub>2</sub> अनुपात के लिए प्रयोग होता है।
hi.scope: IS 381 : 2024 का सोडियम सिलिकेट, द्रव और ठोस (Table 1, Sl No. iii और iv के लिए प्रयोग)। विधि: IS 14212 : 1995, A-7 (Method A)।
hi.principle: परीक्षण भाग की कुल क्षारीयता को hydrochloric acid के standard volumetric solution से, methyl orange indicator की उपस्थिति में, अनुमापित (titrate) करें (A-7.1)।

reagents.name: अभिकर्मकों की गुणवत्ता (A-7.2.1)
reagents.prep: केवल मान्यता प्राप्त analytical grade के अभिकर्मक और केवल distilled water या समान शुद्धता का पानी प्रयोग करें।

reagents.name: Hydrochloric acid, 1 N standard volumetric solution (A-7.2.1 a)
Methyl orange, 0.5 g/l solution (A-7.2.1 b)
reagents.prep: Methyl orange के स्थान पर उसी pH range में end-point वाला कोई अन्य indicator प्रयोग किया जा सकता है।

hi.sampling: नमूना DM/QA/SOP/05 (IS 381, Annex B) के अनुसार लें और तैयार करें। कुल घुलनशील सिलिकेट और Na<sub>2</sub>O : SiO<sub>2</sub> अनुपात के लिए यह परीक्षण किन्हीं तीन यादृच्छिक रूप से चुने गए individual samples पर करें; दोनों परीक्षणों के लिए वही नमूने प्रयोग करें (IS 381, B-4.1)।
procedure: परीक्षण नमूने का 10 ± 1 g, 0.01 g तक तौलें।
परीक्षण भाग को 250-ml one-mark volumetric flask में डालें। पानी से घोलें, निशान तक पतला करें और मिलाएँ।
इस विलयन का इतना आयतन लें कि उसे उदासीन करने में लगभग 20 ml standard hydrochloric acid solution लगे।
5 बूँद methyl orange solution डालें।
Standard volumetric hydrochloric acid solution से तब तक titrate करें जब तक indicator का रंग पीले से orange-pink न हो जाए (V)।
hi.end_point: Methyl orange: पीला से orange-pink।
